Make a Spellcast Roll (15). On a success, place an arcane marking where you stand. The next time you successfully cast Rift Walker, a rift opens giving safe passage back to the marking; it stays open until you close it or cast another spell.
You can drop the spell at any time to cast it again and place the marking elsewhere.

domainCards.name: Telekinesis
domainCards.rules: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Far range. On a success, you can use your mind to move them anywhere within Far range of their original position. You can throw the lifted target as an attack by making an additional Spellcast Roll against the second target you’re trying to attack. On a success, deal d12+4 physical damage to the second target using your Proficiency. This spell then ends.
domainCards.short: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Far range. On a success, move them anywhere within Far range of their original position. Throw the target as an attack with an additional Spellcast Roll against a second target; on a success, deal {{proficiency|#d12+4 physical damage|d12+4 physical damage using your Proficiency}}, and the spell ends.

domainCards.name: Arcana-Touched
domainCards.rules:
When 4 or more of the domain cards in your loadout are from the Arcana domain, gain the following benefits:
- +1 bonus to your Spellcast Rolls
- Once per rest, you can switch the results of your Hope and Fear Dice.
domainCards.short:
When 4 or more loadout cards are from the Arcana domain, gain:
- +1 bonus to your Spellcast Rolls
- Once per rest, switch the results of your Hope and Fear Dice.

domainCards.name: Cloaking Blast
domainCards.rules: When you make a successful Spellcast Roll to cast a different spell, you can spend a Hope to become Cloaked. While Cloaked, you remain unseen if you are stationary when an adversary moves to where they would normally see you. When you move into or within an adversary’s line of sight or make an attack, you are no longer Cloaked.
domainCards.short: When you succeed on a Spellcast Roll to cast a different spell, spend a Hope to become Cloaked: you remain unseen if stationary when an adversary moves to where they would see you. You stop being Cloaked when you move into or within an adversary’s line of sight or make an attack.

domainCards.name: Arcane Reflection
domainCards.rules: When you would take magic damage, you can spend any number of Hope to roll that many d6s. If any roll a 6, the attack is reflected back to the caster, dealing the damage to them instead.
domainCards.short: When you would take magic damage, spend any number of Hope to roll that many d6s. If any roll a 6, the attack is reflected back to the caster, who takes the damage instead.

domainCards.name: Confusing Aura
domainCards.rules: Make a Spellcast Roll (14). Once per long rest on a success, you create a layer of illusion over your body that makes it hard to tell exactly where you are. Mark any number of Stress to make that many additional layers. When an adversary makes an attack against you, roll a number of d6s equal to the number of layers currently active. If any roll a 5 or higher, one layer of the aura is destroyed and the attack fails. If all the results are 4 or lower, you take the damage and this spell ends
domainCards.short: Make a Spellcast Roll (14). Once per long rest on a success, create an illusion layer over your body that hides your position. Mark any number of Stress for that many additional layers. When an adversary attacks you, roll d6s equal to the active layers: on any 5 or higher, one layer is destroyed and the attack fails; if all are 4 or lower, you take the damage and this spell ends.

domainCards.name: Earthquake
domainCards.rules:
Make a Spellcast Roll (16). Once per rest on a success, all targets within Very Far range who aren’t flying must make a Reaction Roll (18). Targets who fail take 3d10+8 physical damage and are temporarily Vulnerable. Targets who succeed take half damage.
Additionally, when you succeed on the Spellcast Roll, all terrain within Very Far range becomes difficult to move through and structures within this range might sustain damage or crumble.
domainCards.short:
Make a Spellcast Roll (16). Once per rest on a success, all non-flying targets within Very Far range make a Reaction Roll (18). Failures take 3d10+8 physical damage and are temporarily Vulnerable; successes take half damage.
Also, all terrain within Very Far range becomes difficult to move through and structures might be damaged or crumble.

domainCards.name: Sensory Projection
domainCards.rules: Once per rest, make a Spellcast Roll (15). On a success, drop into a vision that lets you clearly see and hear any place you have been before as though you are standing there in this moment. You can move freely in this vision and are not constrained by the physics or impediments of a physical body. This spell cannot be detected by mundane or magical means. You drop out of this vision upon taking damage or casting another spell.
domainCards.short: Once per rest, make a Spellcast Roll (15). On a success, drop into a vision that lets you see and hear any place you have been as though standing there. You move freely in it, unconstrained by a physical body, and it can’t be detected by mundane or magical means. You drop out when you take damage or cast another spell.

domainCards.name: Adjust Reality
domainCards.rules: After you or a willing ally make any roll, you can spend 5 Hope to change the numerical result of that roll to a result of your choice instead. The result must be plausible within the range of the dice.
domainCards.short: After you or a willing ally make any roll, spend 5 Hope to change the numerical result to one of your choice, plausible for the dice.

domainCards.name: Falling Sky
domainCards.rules: Make a Spellcast Roll against all adversaries within Far range. Mark any number of Stress to make shards of arcana rain down from above. Targets you succeed against take 1d20+2 magic damage for each Stress marked.
domainCards.short: Make a Spellcast Roll against all adversaries within Far range. Mark any number of Stress to rain shards of arcana: targets you succeed against take 1d20+2 magic damage for each Stress marked.

domainCards.name: Get Back Up
domainCards.rules: When you take Severe damage, you can mark a Stress to reduce the severity by one threshold.
domainCards.short: When you take Severe damage, mark a Stress to reduce the severity by one threshold.

domainCards.name: Not Good Enough
domainCards.rules: When you roll your damage dice, you can reroll any 1s or 2s.
domainCards.short: When you roll damage dice, reroll any 1s or 2s.

domainCards.name: Whirlwind
domainCards.rules: When you make a successful attack against a target within Very Close range, you can spend a Hope to use the attack against all other targets within Very Close range. All additional adversaries you succeed against with this ability take half damage.
domainCards.short: When you succeed on an attack against a target within Very Close range, spend a Hope to use the attack against all other targets within Very Close range. Additional adversaries you succeed against take half damage.

domainCards.name: A Soldier’s Bond
domainCards.rules: Once per long rest, when you compliment someone or ask them about something they’re good at, you can both gain 3 Hope.
domainCards.short: Once per long rest, when you compliment someone or ask them about something they’re good at, you both gain 3 Hope.

domainCards.name: Reckless
domainCards.rules: Mark a Stress to gain advantage on an attack.
domainCards.short: Mark a Stress to gain advantage on an attack.

domainCards.name: Scramble
domainCards.rules: Once per rest, when a creature within Melee range would deal damage to you, you can avoid the attack and safely move out of Melee range of the enemy.
domainCards.short: Once per rest, when a creature within Melee range would deal damage to you, avoid the attack and safely move out of Melee range.

domainCards.name: Versatile Fighter
domainCards.rules:
You can use a different character trait for an equipped weapon, rather than the trait the weapon calls for.
When you deal damage, you can mark a Stress to use the maximum result of one of your damage dice instead of rolling it.
domainCards.short:
Use a different trait for an equipped weapon than the one it calls for.
When you deal damage, mark a Stress to use the maximum result of one damage die instead of rolling it.

domainCards.name: Deadly Focus
domainCards.rules: Once per rest, you can apply all your focus toward a target of your choice. Until you attack another creature, you defeat the target, or the battle ends, gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency.
domainCards.short: Once per rest, apply all your focus to a target of your choice: gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency until you attack another creature, defeat the target, or the battle ends.

domainCards.name: Fortified Armor
domainCards.rules: While you are wearing armor, gain a +2 bonus to your damage thresholds.
domainCards.short: While wearing armor, gain a +2 bonus to your damage thresholds.

domainCards.name: Champion’s Edge
domainCards.rules:
When you critically succeed on an attack, you can spend up to 3 Hope and choose one of the following options for each Hope spent:
- You clear a Hit Point.
- You clear an Armor Slot.
- The target must mark an additional Hit Point.
You can’t choose the same option more than once.
domainCards.short:
When you critically succeed on an attack, spend up to 3 Hope, choosing one option per Hope (each only once):
- You clear a Hit Point.
- You clear an Armor Slot.
- The target marks an additional Hit Point.

domainCards.name: Vitality
domainCards.rules:
When you choose this card, permanently gain two of the following benefits:
- One Stress slot
- One Hit Point slot
- +2 bonus to your damage thresholds Then place this card in your vault permanently.
domainCards.short:
When you choose this card, permanently gain two of the following benefits:
- One Stress slot
- One Hit Point slot
- +2 bonus to your damage thresholds
Then place this card in your vault permanently.

domainCards.name: Battle-Hardened
domainCards.rules: Once per long rest when you would make a Death Move, you can spend a Hope to clear a Hit Point instead.
domainCards.short: Once per long rest, when you would make a Death Move, spend a Hope to clear a Hit Point instead.

domainCards.name: Rage Up
domainCards.rules: Before you make an attack, you can mark a Stress to gain a bonus to your damage roll equal to twice your Strength. You can Rage Up twice per attack.
domainCards.short: Before you attack, mark a Stress to gain {{strength2|a # bonus to your damage roll|a bonus to your damage roll equal to twice your Strength}}. You can Rage Up twice per attack.

domainCards.name: Blade-Touched
domainCards.rules:
When 4 or more of the domain cards in your loadout are from the Blade domain, gain the following benefits:
- +2 bonus to your attack rolls
- +4 bonus to your Severe damage threshold
domainCards.short:
When 4 or more loadout cards are from the Blade domain, gain:
- +2 bonus to your attack rolls
- +4 bonus to your Severe damage threshold

statNote.text: +2 attack rolls, +4 Severe threshold when 4+ loadout cards are from the Blade domain.

domainCards.name: Glancing Blow
domainCards.rules: When you fail an attack, you can mark a Stress to deal weapon damage using half your Proficiency.
domainCards.short: When you fail an attack, mark a Stress to deal weapon damage using {{halfProfUp|a Proficiency of #|half your Proficiency}}.

domainCards.name: Battle Cry
domainCards.rules: Once per long rest, while you’re charging into danger, you can muster a rousing call that inspires your allies. All allies who can hear you each clear a Stress and gain a Hope. Additionally, your allies gain advantage on attack rolls until you or an ally rolls a failure with Fear.
domainCards.short: Once per long rest, while charging into danger, rally your allies: all allies who can hear you each clear a Stress and gain a Hope. They also gain advantage on attack rolls until you or an ally rolls a failure with Fear.

domainCards.name: Frenzy
domainCards.rules:
Once per long rest, you can go into a Frenzy until there are no more adversaries within sight.
While Frenzied, you can’t use Armor Slots, and you gain a +10 bonus to your damage rolls and a +8 bonus to your Severe damage threshold.
domainCards.short:
Once per long rest, go into a Frenzy until there are no adversaries within sight.
While Frenzied, you can’t use Armor Slots and gain a +10 bonus to damage rolls and a +8 bonus to your Severe damage threshold.

domainCards.name: Gore and Glory
domainCards.rules:
When you critically succeed on a weapon attack, gain an additional Hope or clear an additional Stress.
Additionally, when you deal enough damage to defeat an enemy, gain a Hope or clear a Stress.
domainCards.short:
When you critically succeed on a weapon attack, gain an additional Hope or clear an additional Stress.
When you deal enough damage to defeat an enemy, gain a Hope or clear a Stress.

domainCards.name: Reaper’s Strike
domainCards.rules: Once per long rest, spend a Hope to make an attack roll. The GM tells you which targets within range it would succeed against. Choose one of these targets and force them to mark 5 Hit Points.
domainCards.short: Once per long rest, spend a Hope to make an attack roll. The GM tells you which targets within range it would succeed against; choose one and force it to mark 5 Hit Points.

domainCards.name: Battle Monster
domainCards.rules: When you make a successful attack against an adversary, you can mark 4 Stress to force the target to mark a number of Hit Points equal to the number of Hit Points you currently have marked instead of rolling for damage.
domainCards.short: When you succeed on an attack against an adversary, mark 4 Stress to force the target to mark Hit Points equal to the Hit Points you currently have marked, instead of rolling for damage.

domainCards.name: Onslaught
domainCards.rules:
When you successfully make an attack with your weapon, you never deal damage beneath a target’s Major damage threshold (the target always marks a minimum of 2 Hit Points).
Additionally, when a creature within your weapon’s range deals damage to an ally with an attack that doesn’t include you, you can mark a Stress to force them to make a Reaction Roll (15). On a failure, the target must mark a Hit Point.
domainCards.short:
When you successfully attack with your weapon, you never deal damage below the target’s Major damage threshold (it always marks at least 2 Hit Points).
When a creature within your weapon’s range damages an ally with an attack that doesn’t include you, mark a Stress to force them to make a Reaction Roll (15); on a failure, the target marks a Hit Point.

domainCards.name: Deft Maneuvers
domainCards.rules:
Once per rest, mark a Stress to sprint anywhere within Far range without making an Agility Roll to get there.
If you end this movement within Melee range of an adversary and immediately make an attack against them, gain a +1 bonus to the attack roll.
domainCards.short:
Once per rest, mark a Stress to sprint anywhere within Far range without an Agility Roll.
If you end this movement within Melee range of an adversary and immediately attack them, gain a +1 bonus to the attack roll.

domainCards.name: I See It Coming
domainCards.rules: When you’re targeted by an attack made from beyond Melee range, you can mark a Stress to roll a d4 and gain a bonus to your Evasion equal to the result against the attack.
domainCards.short: When you’re targeted by an attack from beyond Melee range, mark a Stress to roll a d4 and gain a bonus to your Evasion equal to the result against that attack.

domainCards.name: Untouchable
domainCards.rules: Gain a bonus to your Evasion equal to half your Agility.
domainCards.short: Gain {{halfAgilityUp|a +# bonus|a bonus equal to half your Agility}} to your Evasion.

domainCards.name: Ferocity
domainCards.rules: When you cause an adversary to mark 1 or more Hit Points, you can spend 2 Hope to increase your Evasion by the number of Hit Points they marked. This bonus lasts until after the next attack made against you.
domainCards.short: When you cause an adversary to mark 1 or more Hit Points, spend 2 Hope to increase your Evasion by the number they marked, until after the next attack made against you.

domainCards.name: Strategic Approach
domainCards.rules:
After a long rest, place a number of tokens equal to your Knowledge on this card (minimum 1). The first time you move within Close range of an adversary and make an attack against them, you can spend one token to choose one of the following options:
- You make the attack with advantage.
- You clear a Stress on an ally within Melee range of the adversary.
- You add a d8 to your damage roll.
When you take a long rest, clear all unspent tokens.
domainCards.short:
After a long rest, place {{knowledgeMin1|# tokens|tokens equal to your Knowledge (minimum 1)}} on this card. The first time you move within Close range of an adversary and attack them, spend a token to choose one:
- You attack with advantage.
- You clear a Stress on an ally within Melee range of the adversary.
- You add a d8 to your damage roll.
When you take a long rest, clear unspent tokens.

domainCards.name: Brace
domainCards.rules: When you mark an Armor Slot to reduce incoming damage, you can mark a Stress to mark an additional Armor Slot.
domainCards.short: When you mark an Armor Slot to reduce incoming damage, mark a Stress to mark an additional Armor Slot.

domainCards.name: Tactician
domainCards.rules: When you Help an Ally, they can spend a Hope to add one of your Experiences to their roll alongside your advantage die. When making a Tag Team Roll, you can roll a d20 as your Hope Die.
domainCards.short: When you Help an Ally, they can spend a Hope to add one of your Experiences to their roll alongside your advantage die. On a Tag Team Roll, you can roll a d20 as your Hope Die.

domainCards.name: Boost
domainCards.rules: Mark a Stress to boost off a willing ally within Close range, fling yourself into the air, and perform an aerial attack against a target within Far range. You have advantage on the attack, add a d10 to the damage roll, and end your move within Melee range of the target.
domainCards.short: Mark a Stress to boost off a willing ally within Close range and make an aerial attack against a target within Far range: advantage on the attack, add a d10 to the damage roll, and end your move within Melee range of the target.

domainCards.name: Redirect
domainCards.rules: When an attack made against you from beyond Melee range fails, roll a number of d6s equal to your Proficiency. If any roll a 6, you can mark a Stress to redirect the attack to damage an adversary within Very Close range instead.
domainCards.short: When an attack from beyond Melee range against you fails, roll {{proficiency|#d6|a number of d6s equal to your Proficiency}}. If any roll a 6, mark a Stress to redirect the attack to damage an adversary within Very Close range.

domainCards.name: Know Thy Enemy
domainCards.rules:
When observing a creature, you can make an Instinct Roll against them. On a success, spend a Hope and ask the GM for one set of information about the target from the following options:
- Their unmarked Hit Points and Stress.
- Their Difficulty and damage thresholds.
- Their tactics and standard attack damage dice.
- Their features and Experiences.
Additionally on a success, you can mark a Stress to remove a Fear from the GM’s Fear Pool.
domainCards.short:
When observing a creature, make an Instinct Roll against them. On a success, spend a Hope and ask the GM for one set of information about the target:
- Their unmarked Hit Points and Stress.
- Their Difficulty and damage thresholds.
- Their tactics and standard attack damage dice.
- Their features and Experiences.
Also on a success, you can mark a Stress to remove a Fear from the GM’s Fear Pool.

domainCards.name: Signature Move
domainCards.rules: Name and describe your signature combat move. Once per rest, when you perform this signature move as part of an action you’re taking, you can roll a d20 as your Hope Die. On a success, clear a Stress.
domainCards.short: Name and describe your signature combat move. Once per rest, when you perform it as part of an action, you can roll a d20 as your Hope Die. On a success, clear a Stress.

domainCards.name: Rapid Riposte
domainCards.rules: When an attack made against you from within Melee range fails, you can mark a Stress and seize the opportunity to deal the weapon damage of one of your active weapons to the attacker.
domainCards.short: When an attack against you from within Melee range fails, mark a Stress to deal the weapon damage of one of your active weapons to the attacker.

domainCards.name: Recovery
domainCards.rules: During a short rest, you can choose a long rest downtime move instead. You can spend a Hope to let an ally do the same.
domainCards.short: During a short rest, you can choose a long rest downtime move instead. Spend a Hope to let an ally do the same.

domainCards.name: Bone-Touched
domainCards.rules:
When 4 or more of the domain cards in your loadout are from the Bone domain, gain the following benefits:
- +1 bonus to Agility
- Once per rest, you can spend 3 Hope to cause an attack that succeeded against you to fail instead.
domainCards.short:
When 4 or more loadout cards are from the Bone domain, gain:
- +1 bonus to Agility
- Once per rest, spend 3 Hope to make an attack that succeeded against you fail instead.

domainCards.name: Cruel Precision
domainCards.rules: When you make a successful attack with a weapon, gain a bonus to your damage roll equal to either your Finesse or Agility.
domainCards.short: When you make a successful weapon attack, gain {{finesseOrAgility|a # bonus to your damage roll|a bonus to your damage roll equal to either your Finesse or Agility}}.

domainCards.name: Breaking Blow
domainCards.rules: When you make a successful attack, you can mark a Stress to make the next successful attack against that same target deal an extra 2d12 damage.
domainCards.short: When you make a successful attack, mark a Stress to make the next successful attack against the same target deal an extra 2d12 damage.

domainCards.name: Wrangle
domainCards.rules: Make an Agility Roll against all targets within Close range. Spend a Hope to move targets you succeed against, and any willing allies within Close range, to another point within Close range.
domainCards.short: Make an Agility Roll against all targets within Close range. Spend a Hope to move targets you succeed against and willing allies within Close range to another point within Close range.

domainCards.name: On the Brink
domainCards.rules: When you have 2 or fewer Hit Points unmarked, you don’t take Minor damage.
domainCards.short: When you have 2 or fewer Hit Points unmarked, you don’t take Minor damage.

domainCards.name: Splintering Strike
domainCards.rules: Spend a Hope and make an attack against all adversaries within your weapon’s range. Once per long rest, on a success against any targets, roll your weapon's damage and distribute that damage however you wish between the targets you succeeded against. Before you deal damage to each target, roll an additional damage die and add its result to the damage you deal to them.
domainCards.short: Spend a Hope and attack all adversaries within your weapon’s range. Once per long rest, on a success against any targets, roll your weapon’s damage and distribute it among the targets you succeeded against as you wish. Before dealing damage to each target, roll an additional damage die and add it to that target’s damage.

domainCards.name: Deathrun
domainCards.rules:
Spend 3 Hope to run a straight path through the battlefield to a point within Far range, making an attack against all adversaries within your weapon’s range along that path. Choose the order in which you deal damage to the targets you succeeded against. For the first, roll your weapon damage with a +1 bonus to your Proficiency. Then remove a die from your damage roll and deal the remaining damage to the next target. Continue to remove a die for each subsequent target until you have no more damage dice or adversaries.
You can’t target the same adversary more than once per attack.
domainCards.short:
Spend 3 Hope to run a straight path to a point within Far range, attacking all adversaries within your weapon’s range along it. Choose the order you damage the targets you succeeded against. For the first, roll your weapon damage with a +1 bonus to your Proficiency; then remove a die from the roll for each subsequent target and deal the rest to the next, until no dice or adversaries remain.
You can’t target the same adversary more than once per attack.

domainCards.name: Swift Step
domainCards.rules: When an attack made against you fails, clear a Stress. If you can’t clear a Stress, gain a Hope.
domainCards.short: When an attack against you fails, clear a Stress. If you can’t, gain a Hope.

domainCards.name: Book of Ava
domainCards.rules:
Power Push: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Melee range.
On a success, they’re knocked back to Far range and take d10+2 magic damage using your Proficiency.
Tava’s Armor: Spend a Hope to give a target you can touch a +1 bonus to their Armor Score until their next rest or you cast Tava’s Armor again.
Ice Spike: Make a Spellcast Roll (12) to summon a large ice spike within Far range. If you use it as a weapon, make the Spellcast Roll against the target’s Difficulty instead. On a success, deal d6 physical damage using your Proficiency.
domainCards.short:
Power Push: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Melee range. On a success, they’re knocked back to Far range and take {{proficiency|#d10+2 magic damage|d10+2 magic damage using your Proficiency}}.
Tava’s Armor: Spend a Hope to give a target you can touch a +1 bonus to their Armor Score until their next rest or you cast Tava’s Armor again.
Ice Spike: Make a Spellcast Roll (12) to summon a large ice spike within Far range. If used as a weapon, roll against the target’s Difficulty instead. On a success, deal {{proficiency|#d6 physical damage|d6 physical damage using your Proficiency}}.

domainCards.name: Book of Illiat
domainCards.rules:
Slumber: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Very Close range. On a success, they’re Asleep until they take damage or the GM spends a Fear on their turn to clear this condition.
Arcane Barrage: Once per rest, spend any number of Hope and shoot magical projectiles that strike a target of your choice within Close range. Roll a number of d6s equal to the Hope spent and deal that much magic damage to the target.
Telepathy: Spend a Hope to open a line of mental communication with one target you can see. This connection lasts until your next rest or you cast Telepathy again.
domainCards.short:
Slumber: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Very Close range. On a success, they’re Asleep until they take damage or the GM spends a Fear on their turn to clear the condition.
Arcane Barrage: Once per rest, spend any number of Hope to shoot magical projectiles at a target within Close range: roll d6s equal to the Hope spent and deal that much magic damage.
Telepathy: Spend a Hope to open a line of mental communication with one target you can see, lasting until your next rest or you cast Telepathy again.

domainCards.name: Book of Tyfar
domainCards.rules:
Wild Flame: Make a Spellcast Roll against up to three adversaries within Melee range. Targets you succeed against take 2d6 magic damage and must mark a Stress as flames erupt from your hand.
Magic Hand: You conjure a magical hand with the same size and strength as your own within Far range.
Mysterious Mist: Make a Spellcast Roll (13) to cast a temporary thick fog that gathers in a stationary area within Very Close range. The fog heavily obscures this area and everything in it.
domainCards.short:
Wild Flame: Make a Spellcast Roll against up to three adversaries within Melee range. Targets you succeed against take 2d6 magic damage and must mark a Stress.
Magic Hand: Conjure a magical hand with the same size and strength as your own within Far range.
Mysterious Mist: Make a Spellcast Roll (13) to cast a temporary thick fog in a stationary area within Very Close range, heavily obscuring the area and everything in it.

domainCards.name: Book of Sitil
domainCards.rules:
Adjust Appearance: You magically shift your appearance and clothing to avoid recognition.
Parallela: Spend 2 Hope to cast this spell on yourself or an ally within Close range. The next time the target makes an attack, they can hit an additional target within range that their attack roll would succeed against. You can only hold this spell on one creature at a time.
Illusion: Make a Spellcast Roll (14).
On a success, create a temporary visual illusion no larger than you within Close range that lasts for as long as you look at it. It holds up to scrutiny until an observer is within Melee range.
domainCards.short:
Adjust Appearance: Magically shift your appearance and clothing to avoid recognition.
Parallela: Spend 2 Hope to cast this on yourself or an ally within Close range. The next time the target attacks, they can hit an additional target within range that their attack roll would succeed against. You can hold this spell on only one creature at a time.
Illusion: Make a Spellcast Roll (14). On a success, create a temporary visual illusion no larger than you within Close range, lasting as long as you look at it. It holds up to scrutiny until an observer is within Melee range.

domainCards.name: Book of Vagras
domainCards.rules:
Runic Lock: Make a Spellcast Roll (15) on an object you’re touching that can close (such as a lock, chest, or box). Once per rest on a success, you can lock the object so it can only be opened by creatures of your choice. Someone with access to magic and an hour of time to study the spell can break it.
Arcane Door: When you have no adversaries within Melee range, make a Spellcast Roll (13). On a success, spend a Hope to create a portal from where you are to a point within Far range you can see. It closes once a creature has passed through it.
Reveal: Make a Spellcast Roll. If there is anything magically hidden within Close range, it is revealed.
domainCards.short:
Runic Lock: Make a Spellcast Roll (15) on a closable object you’re touching (lock, chest, box). Once per rest on a success, lock it so only creatures of your choice can open it. Someone with access to magic and an hour to study the spell can break it.
Arcane Door: With no adversaries within Melee range, make a Spellcast Roll (13). On a success, spend a Hope to create a portal from where you are to a point you can see within Far range. It closes once a creature passes through.
Reveal: Make a Spellcast Roll. Anything magically hidden within Close range is revealed.

domainCards.name: Book of Korvax
domainCards.rules:
Levitation: Make a Spellcast Roll to temporarily lift a target you can see up into the air and move them within Close range of their original position.
Recant: Spend a Hope to force a target within Melee range to make a Reaction Roll (15). On a failure, they forget the last minute of your conversation.
Rune Circle: Mark a Stress to create a temporary magical circle on the ground where you stand. All adversaries within Melee range, or who enter Melee range, take 2d12+4 magic damage and are knocked back to Very Close range.
domainCards.short:
Levitation: Make a Spellcast Roll to temporarily lift a target you can see into the air and move them within Close range of their original position.
Recant: Spend a Hope to force a target within Melee range to make a Reaction Roll (15). On a failure, they forget the last minute of your conversation.
Rune Circle: Mark a Stress to create a temporary magical circle where you stand. Adversaries within Melee range, or who enter it, take 2d12+4 magic damage and are knocked back to Very Close range.

domainCards.name: Book of Norai
domainCards.rules:
Mystic Tether: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Far range. On a success, they’re temporarily Restrained and must mark a Stress. If you target a flying creature, this spell grounds and temporarily Restrains them.
Fireball: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Very Far range. On a success, hurl a sphere of fire toward them that explodes on impact. The target and all creatures within Very Close range of them must make a Reaction Roll (13). Targets who fail take d20+5 magic damage using your Proficiency. Targets who succeed take half damage.
domainCards.short:
Mystic Tether: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Far range. On a success, they’re temporarily Restrained and must mark a Stress. A flying target is grounded and temporarily Restrained.
Fireball: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Very Far range. On a success, hurl an exploding sphere of fire: the target and all creatures within Very Close range of them make a Reaction Roll (13). Those who fail take {{proficiency|#d20+5 magic damage|d20+5 magic damage using your Proficiency}}; those who succeed take half.

domainCards.name: Book of Exota
domainCards.rules:
Repudiate: You can interrupt a magical effect taking place. Make a reaction roll using your Spellcast trait. Once per rest on a success, the effect stops and any consequences are avoided.
Create Construct: Spend a Hope to choose a group of objects around you and create an animated construct from them that obeys basic commands. Make a Spellcast Roll to command them to take action. When necessary, they share your Evasion and traits and their attacks deal 2d10+3 physical damage. You can only maintain one construct at a time, and they fall apart when they take any amount of damage.
domainCards.short:
Repudiate: Interrupt a magical effect with a reaction roll using your Spellcast trait. Once per rest on a success, the effect stops and any consequences are avoided.
Create Construct: Spend a Hope to animate a group of objects around you into a construct that obeys basic commands. Make a Spellcast Roll to command it. When necessary, it shares your Evasion and traits, and its attacks deal 2d10+3 physical damage. You can maintain only one construct, and it falls apart when it takes any damage.

domainCards.name: Book of Grynn
domainCards.rules:
Arcane Deflection: Once per long rest, spend a Hope to negate the damage of an attack targeting you or an ally within Very Close range.
Time Lock: Target an object within Far range. That object stops in time and space exactly where it is until your next rest. If a creature tries to move it, make a Spellcast Roll against them to maintain this spell.
Wall of Flame: Make a Spellcast Roll (15). On a success, create a temporary wall of magical flame between two points within Far range. All creatures in its path must choose a side to be on, and anything that subsequently passes through the wall takes 4d10+3 magic damage.
domainCards.short:
Arcane Deflection: Once per long rest, spend a Hope to negate the damage of an attack targeting you or an ally within Very Close range.
Time Lock: Target an object within Far range; it stops in time and space until your next rest. If a creature tries to move it, make a Spellcast Roll against them to maintain the spell.
Wall of Flame: Make a Spellcast Roll (15). On a success, create a temporary wall of magical flame between two points within Far range. Creatures in its path choose a side, and anything that later passes through takes 4d10+3 magic damage.

domainCards.name: Manifest Wall
domainCards.rules: Make a Spellcast Roll (15). Once per rest on a success, spend a Hope to create a temporary magical wall between two points within Far range. It can be up to 50 feet high and form at any angle. Creatures or objects in its path are shunted to a side of your choice. The wall stays up until your next rest or you cast Manifest Wall again.
domainCards.short: Make a Spellcast Roll (15). Once per rest on a success, spend a Hope to create a temporary magical wall between two points within Far range, up to 50 feet high and at any angle. Creatures or objects in its path are shunted to a side of your choice. The wall stays up until your next rest or you cast Manifest Wall again.

domainCards.name: Teleport
domainCards.rules:
Once per long rest, you can instantly teleport yourself and any number of willing targets within Close range to a place you’ve been before. Choose one of the following options, then make a Spellcast Roll (16):
- If you know the place very well, gain a +3 bonus.
- If you’ve visited the place frequently, gain a +1 bonus.
- If you’ve visited the place infrequently, gain no modifier.
- If you’ve only been there once, gain a −2 penalty.
On a success, you appear where you were intending to go. On a failure, you appear off course, with the range of failure determining how far off course.
domainCards.short: Once per long rest, instantly teleport yourself and any number of willing targets within Close range to a place you’ve been before. Make a Spellcast Roll (16), modified by how well you know the place. On a success, you arrive as intended; on a failure, you appear off course, the range of failure determining how far.

domainCards.name: Banish
domainCards.rules:
Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Close range. On a success, roll a number of d20s equal to your Spellcast trait. The target must make a reaction roll with a Difficulty equal to your highest result. On a success, the target must mark a Stress but isn’t banished. Once per rest on a failure, they are banished from this realm.
When the PCs roll with Fear, the Difficulty gains a −1 penalty and the target makes another reaction roll. On a success, they return from banishment.
domainCards.short:
Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Close range. On a success, roll {{spellcast|#d20|a number of d20s equal to your Spellcast trait}}; the target makes a reaction roll with Difficulty equal to your highest result. On a success, the target marks a Stress but isn’t banished. Once per rest on a failure, they are banished from this realm.
When the PCs roll with Fear, the Difficulty gets a −1 penalty and the target makes another reaction roll; on a success, they return from banishment.

domainCards.name: Sigil of Retribution
domainCards.rules: Mark an adversary within Close range with a sigil of retribution. The GM gains a Fear. When the marked adversary deals damage to you or your allies, place a d8 on this card. You can hold a number of d8s equal to your level. When you successfully attack the marked adversary, roll the dice on this card and add the total to your damage roll, then clear the dice. This effect ends when the marked adversary is defeated or you cast Sigil of Retribution again.
domainCards.short: Mark an adversary within Close range with a sigil of retribution. The GM gains a Fear. When the marked adversary deals damage to you or your allies, place a d8 on this card (you can hold {{level|up to # d8s|a number of d8s equal to your level}}). When you successfully attack the marked adversary, roll the dice on this card, add the total to your damage roll, then clear them. This ends when the adversary is defeated or you cast Sigil of Retribution again.

domainCards.name: Book of Homet
domainCards.rules:
Pass Through: Make a Spellcast Roll (13). Once per rest on a success, you and all creatures touching you can pass through a wall or door within Close range. The effect ends once everyone is on the other side.
Plane Gate: Make a Spellcast Roll (14). Once per long rest on a success, open a gateway to a location in another dimension or plane of existence you’ve been to before. This gateway lasts until your next rest.
domainCards.short:
Pass Through: Make a Spellcast Roll (13). Once per rest on a success, you and all creatures touching you can pass through a wall or door within Close range; the effect ends once everyone is through.
Plane Gate: Make a Spellcast Roll (14). Once per long rest on a success, open a gateway to a location in another dimension or plane you’ve been to before, lasting until your next rest.

domainCards.name: Codex-Touched
domainCards.rules:
When 4 or more of the domain cards in your loadout are from the Codex domain, gain the following benefits:
- You can mark a Stress to add your Proficiency to a Spellcast Roll.
- Once per rest, replace this card with any card from your vault without paying its Recall Cost.
domainCards.short:
When 4 or more loadout cards are from the Codex domain, gain:
- Mark a Stress to add {{proficiency|+#|your Proficiency}} to a Spellcast Roll.
- Once per rest, replace this card with any card from your vault without paying its Recall Cost.

domainCards.name: Book of Vyola
domainCards.rules:
Memory Delve: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Far range. On a success, peer into the target’s mind and ask the GM a question. The GM describes any memories the target has pertaining to the answer.
Shared Clarity: Once per long rest, spend a Hope to choose two willing creatures. When one of them would mark Stress, they can choose between the two of them who marks it. This spell lasts until their next rest.
domainCards.short:
Memory Delve: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Far range. On a success, peer into their mind and ask the GM a question; the GM describes any memories the target has pertaining to the answer.
Shared Clarity: Once per long rest, spend a Hope to choose two willing creatures. When one would mark Stress, they can choose which of the two marks it. Lasts until their next rest.

domainCards.name: Safe Haven
domainCards.rules: When you have a few minutes of calm to focus, you can spend 2 Hope to summon your Safe Haven, a large interdimensional home where you and your allies can take shelter. When you do, a magical door appears somewhere within Close range. Only creatures of your choice can enter. Once inside, you can make the entrance invisible. You and anyone else inside can always exit. Once you leave, the doorway must be summoned again. When you take a rest within your own Safe Haven, you can choose an additional downtime move.
domainCards.short: With a few minutes of calm to focus, spend 2 Hope to summon your Safe Haven, a large interdimensional home where you and your allies can shelter. A magical door appears within Close range; only creatures of your choice can enter, and once inside you can make the entrance invisible. Anyone inside can always exit; once you leave, the doorway must be summoned again. When you rest within your Safe Haven, you can choose an additional downtime move.

domainCards.name: Book of Ronin
domainCards.rules:
Transform: Make a Spellcast Roll (15). On a success, transform into an inanimate object no larger than twice your normal size. You can remain in this shape until you take damage.
Eternal Enervation: Once per long rest, make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Close range. On a success, they become permanently Vulnerable. They can’t clear this condition by any means.
domainCards.short:
Transform: Make a Spellcast Roll (15). On a success, transform into an inanimate object no larger than twice your normal size, remaining in that shape until you take damage.
Eternal Enervation: Once per long rest, make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Close range. On a success, they become permanently Vulnerable and can’t clear the condition by any means.

domainCards.name: Disintegration Wave
domainCards.rules: Make a Spellcast Roll (18). Once per long rest on a success, the GM tells you which adversaries within Far range have a Difficulty of 18 or lower. Mark a Stress for each one you wish to hit with this spell. They are killed and can’t come back to life by any means.
domainCards.short: Make a Spellcast Roll (18). Once per long rest on a success, the GM tells you which adversaries within Far range have a Difficulty of 18 or lower. Mark a Stress for each you wish to hit; they are killed and can’t come back to life by any means.

domainCards.name: Book of Yarrow
domainCards.rules:
Timejammer: Make a Spellcast Roll (18). On a success, time temporarily slows to a halt for everyone within Far range except for you. It resumes the next time you make an action roll that targets another creature.
Magic Immunity: Spend 5 Hope to become immune to magic damage until your next rest.
domainCards.short:
Timejammer: Make a Spellcast Roll (18). On a success, time temporarily stops for everyone within Far range except you, resuming the next time you make an action roll that targets another creature.
Magic Immunity: Spend 5 Hope to become immune to magic damage until your next rest.

domainCards.name: Transcendent Union
domainCards.rules: Once per long rest, spend 5 Hope to cast this spell on two or more willing creatures. Until your next rest, when a creature connected by this union would mark Stress or Hit Points, the connected creatures can choose who marks it.
domainCards.short: Once per long rest, spend 5 Hope to cast this on two or more willing creatures. Until your next rest, when a creature connected by this union would mark Stress or Hit Points, the connected creatures can choose who marks it.

domainCards.name: Blighting Strike
domainCards.rules:
Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Far range. On a success:
- On a roll with Hope, deal d6+1 magic damage using your Proficiency. On a roll with Fear, deal d10+1 magic damage using your Proficiency.
- The target’s next successful attack deals half damage. On a failure, you must spend a Hope or mark a Stress.
domainCards.short:
Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Far range. On a success:
- On a roll with Hope, deal {{proficiency|#d6+1 magic damage|d6+1 magic damage using your Proficiency}}. On a roll with Fear, deal {{proficiency|#d10+1 magic damage|d10+1 magic damage using your Proficiency}}.
- The target’s next successful attack deals half damage. On a failure, you must spend a Hope or mark a Stress.

domainCards.name: Umbral Veil
domainCards.rules:
Once per rest, you can mark a Stress to encase yourself in shadowy energy. When you do, place a number of tokens on this card equal to the number of Fear in the GM’s pool. After an attack roll is made against you, you can spend any number of tokens to give the result a −1 penalty per token spent.
At the end of the scene, clear all unspent tokens.
domainCards.short:
Once per rest, mark a Stress to encase yourself in shadowy energy, placing tokens on this card equal to the Fear in the GM’s pool. After an attack roll is made against you, spend any number of tokens to give the result a −1 penalty per token spent.
At the end of the scene, clear unspent tokens.

domainCards.name: Voice of Dread
domainCards.rules: You can magically speak to a creature you can see, tormenting them with your words. Make a Spellcast Roll against them. On a success, they must mark a Stress and are frozen with terror, making them temporarily Restrained.
domainCards.short: Magically speak to a creature you can see, tormenting them. Make a Spellcast Roll against them. On a success, they mark a Stress and are frozen with terror, temporarily Restrained.

domainCards.name: Hideous Retribution
domainCards.rules: When an ally within Close range takes damage from a target you can see, you can make a reaction roll against the target using your Spellcast trait. On a success, mark a Stress to deal d6 magic damage using your Proficiency.
domainCards.short: When an ally within Close range takes damage from a target you can see, make a reaction roll against the target using your Spellcast trait. On a success, mark a Stress to deal {{proficiency|#d6 magic damage|d6 magic damage using your Proficiency}}.

domainCards.name: Siphon Essence
domainCards.rules:
Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Very Close range. Once per long rest on a success, the target takes d12+4 magic damage using your Proficiency. On a success with Fear, you gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency for this attack.
You clear a number of Hit Points equal to the number of Hit Points the target marked from this attack.
domainCards.short:
Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Very Close range. Once per long rest on a success, the target takes {{proficiency|#d12+4 magic damage|d12+4 magic damage using your Proficiency}}. On a success with Fear, gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency for this attack.
You clear Hit Points equal to the Hit Points the target marked from this attack.

domainCards.name: Shared Trauma
domainCards.rules: You can transfer suffering from one creature to another. Once per rest, mark any number of Hit Points on a willing creature within Melee range to clear an equal number of Hit Points on another willing creature within Melee range.
domainCards.short: Once per rest, transfer suffering: mark any number of Hit Points on a willing creature within Melee range to clear an equal number on another willing creature within Melee range.

domainCards.name: Terrify
domainCards.rules: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Close range. On a success, the target marks 1d4 Stress, and you can make the target flee one range away from you (such as Very Close to Close or Close to Far). On a success with Fear, the target also becomes temporarily Vulnerable.
domainCards.short: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Close range. On a success, the target marks 1d4 Stress and you can make it flee one range away from you (such as Very Close to Close or Close to Far). On a success with Fear, the target also becomes temporarily Vulnerable.

domainCards.name: Chains of Affliction
domainCards.rules:
Mark 2 Stress to temporarily Chain a target within Close range. When a Chained creature deals damage, the target of their attack marks one fewer Hit Point than they normally would. You can’t have more than one creature Chained at a time.
#### Summon
domainCards.short: Mark 2 Stress to temporarily Chain a target within Close range. When a Chained creature deals damage, the target of their attack marks one fewer Hit Point. You can Chain only one creature at a time.

domainCards.name: Horror
domainCards.rules:
Once per scene, mark a Stress to summon an otherworldly creature that deals d8+1 magic damage using your Spellcast trait to a target within Far range. If the target marks any Hit Points from this attack, they must succeed on a Reaction Roll (12) to steel themselves against the horror or mark an equal number of Stress.
After making the attack, the creature dissipates.
domainCards.short:
Once per scene, mark a Stress to summon an otherworldly creature that deals d8+1 magic damage using your Spellcast trait to a target within Far range. If the target marks any Hit Points, they must succeed on a Reaction Roll (12) or mark an equal number of Stress.
After the attack, the creature dissipates.

domainCards.name: Dire Strike
domainCards.rules: When a target marks any number of Hit Points from an attack you make, you can spend a Hope to drain power from them. The GM loses a Fear.
domainCards.short: When a target marks Hit Points from an attack you make, spend a Hope to drain power from them; the GM loses a Fear.

domainCards.name: Spectral Mist
domainCards.rules: Spend 2 Hope to conjure an eerie mist that turns you and allies of your choice within Close range momentarily incorporeal. While a creature is incorporeal, they can move through solid objects and are immune to physical damage. They become corporeal again after they pass through a solid object or make an action roll. Otherwise, this effect lasts until the end of the scene.
domainCards.short: Spend 2 Hope to conjure an eerie mist that makes you and allies of your choice within Close range momentarily incorporeal: they can move through solid objects and are immune to physical damage. They become corporeal after passing through a solid object or making an action roll; otherwise this lasts until the end of the scene.

domainCards.name: Darkfire
domainCards.rules: Once per scene, spend any number of Hope to target an equal number of adversaries within Close range. Each target makes a Reaction Roll (15). Targets who fail take d8+6 magic damage using your Spellcast trait as they are engulfed in dark fire. Targets who succeed take half damage.
domainCards.short: Once per scene, spend any number of Hope to target that many adversaries within Close range. Each makes a Reaction Roll (15). Targets who fail take d8+6 magic damage using your Spellcast trait; those who succeed take half damage.

domainCards.name: Jump Scare
domainCards.rules: When you deal magic damage to a target, you can mark a Stress to teleport into Melee range with them. When you do, they are Vulnerable until they mark 1 or more Hit Points.
domainCards.short: When you deal magic damage to a target, mark a Stress to teleport into Melee range with them. They are Vulnerable until they mark 1 or more Hit Points.

domainCards.name: Dread-Touched
domainCards.rules:
When 4 or more of the domain cards in your loadout are from the Dread domain, gain the following benefits:
- When you succeed with Fear, you can mark 2 Stress to prevent the GM from gaining a Fear.
- Once per rest when making an action roll, you can gain a bonus to the roll equal to the number of Fear in the GM’s pool.
domainCards.short:
When 4 or more loadout cards are from the Dread domain, gain:
- When you succeed with Fear, mark 2 Stress to prevent the GM from gaining a Fear.
- Once per rest when making an action roll, gain a bonus equal to the Fear in the GM’s pool.

domainCards.name: Wall of Hunger
domainCards.rules: Make a Spellcast Roll (10). On a success, you can spend a Hope to create a visible wall of writhing necrotic energy between two points within Far range. The wall lasts until you mark a Hit Point or cast this spell again. A creature inside the wall when it appears or that passes through it must mark 2 Stress.
domainCards.short: Make a Spellcast Roll (10). On a success, spend a Hope to create a visible wall of writhing necrotic energy between two points within Far range. It lasts until you mark a Hit Point or cast this spell again. A creature inside the wall when it appears, or passing through it, marks 2 Stress.

domainCards.name: Dark Army
domainCards.rules:
Make a Spellcast Roll (14). Once per long rest on a success, you can summon fiends that surround and move with you. Place 8 tokens on this card. When you deal damage to a target within Very Close range, you can spend any number of tokens to add 1d8 for each token spent to your damage roll. Additionally, when you take damage, you can spend any number of tokens to reduce the damage by 1d8 for each token spent. Each time you spend a token, a fiend acts on your behalf, then disappears.
When you take a rest, clear all unspent tokens.
domainCards.short:
Make a Spellcast Roll (14). Once per long rest on a success, summon fiends that surround and move with you; place 8 tokens on this card. When you deal damage to a target within Very Close range, spend any number of tokens to add 1d8 per token to your damage roll. When you take damage, spend any number of tokens to reduce it by 1d8 per token. Each token spent has a fiend act on your behalf, then disappear.
When you take a rest, clear unspent tokens.

domainCards.name: Eldritch Flesh
domainCards.rules:
Gain a +1 bonus to your damage thresholds for each Stress you have marked.
Additionally, when you roll with Fear, you can spend 2 Hope to clear an Armor Slot.

Gain a +1 bonus to your damage thresholds for each Stress you have marked.
When you roll with Fear, spend 2 Hope to clear an Armor Slot.

domainCards.name: Damnation
domainCards.rules: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Far range. On a success, mark any number of Stress to roll an equal number of d20s, dealing magic damage equal to the total result. If this attack defeats the target, all adversaries within Far range of the target must mark a Stress.
domainCards.short: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Far range. On a success, mark any number of Stress to roll that many d20s, dealing magic damage equal to the total result. If this defeats the target, all adversaries within Far range of it mark a Stress.

domainCards.name: Savor the Anguish
domainCards.rules: When an adversary within Close range takes Severe damage, you can clear a Stress.
domainCards.short: When an adversary within Close range takes Severe damage, you can clear a Stress.

domainCards.name: Avatar of Terror
domainCards.rules:
Mark a Stress to transform into a creature fueled by fear. While in this form, you gain a 1d6 bonus to your damage rolls for each Fear in the GM’s pool. Additionally, you gain a Hope when the GM spends a Fear to spotlight an adversary within Very Close range.
Before you make an action roll, you must spend a Hope. If you can’t, you revert to your normal form.

domainCards.name: Invoke Torment
domainCards.rules:
You deal double damage to targets that have all their Stress marked.
Additionally, when an adversary within Close range is defeated with all its Stress marked, you gain a Hope..
domainCards.short:
You deal double damage to targets with all their Stress marked.
When an adversary within Close range is defeated with all its Stress marked, gain a Hope.

domainCards.name: Deft Deceiver
domainCards.rules: Spend a Hope to gain advantage on a roll to deceive or trick someone into believing a lie you tell them.
domainCards.short: Spend a Hope to gain advantage on a roll to deceive or trick someone into believing a lie you tell.

domainCards.name: Enrapture
domainCards.rules: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Close range. On a success, they become temporarily Enraptured. While Enraptured, a target’s attention is fixed on you, narrowing their field of view and drowning out any sound but your voice. Once per rest on a success, you can mark a Stress to force the Enraptured target to mark a Stress as well.
domainCards.short: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Close range. On a success, they become temporarily Enraptured: their attention is fixed on you, narrowing their view and drowning out all sound but your voice. Once per rest on a success, mark a Stress to force the Enraptured target to mark a Stress too.

domainCards.name: Inspirational Words
domainCards.rules:
Your speech is imbued with power. After a long rest, place a number of tokens on this card equal to your Presence. When you speak with an ally, you can spend a token from this card to give them one benefit from the following options:
- Your ally clears a Stress.
- Your ally clears a Hit Point.
- Your ally gains a Hope.
When you take a long rest, clear all unspent tokens.
domainCards.short:
After a long rest, place {{presence|# tokens|tokens equal to your Presence}} on this card. When you speak with an ally, spend a token to give them one benefit:
- Your ally clears a Stress.
- Your ally clears a Hit Point.
- Your ally gains a Hope.
When you take a long rest, clear unspent tokens.

domainCards.name: Tell No Lies
domainCards.rules: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Very Close range. On a success, they can’t lie to you while they remain within Close range, but they are not compelled to speak. If you ask them a question and they refuse to answer, they must mark a Stress and the effect ends. The target is typically unaware this spell has been cast on them until it causes them to utter the truth.
domainCards.short: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Very Close range. On a success, they can’t lie to you while within Close range, but aren’t compelled to speak. If you ask a question and they refuse to answer, they mark a Stress and the effect ends. The target is typically unaware of the spell until it makes them utter the truth.

domainCards.name: Troublemaker
domainCards.rules: When you taunt or provoke a target within Far range, make a Presence Roll against them. Once per rest on a success, roll a number of d4s equal to your Proficiency. The target must mark Stress equal to the highest result rolled.
domainCards.short: When you taunt or provoke a target within Far range, make a Presence Roll against them. Once per rest on a success, roll {{proficiency|#d4|a number of d4s equal to your Proficiency}}; the target marks Stress equal to the highest result.

domainCards.name: Hypnotic Shimmer
domainCards.rules: Make a Spellcast Roll against all adversaries in front of you within Close range. Once per rest on a success, create an illusion of flashing colors and lights that temporarily Stuns targets you succeed against and forces them to mark a Stress. While Stunned, they can’t use reactions and can’t take any other actions until they clear this condition.
domainCards.short: Make a Spellcast Roll against all adversaries in front of you within Close range. Once per rest on a success, create an illusion of flashing colors and lights that temporarily Stuns targets you succeed against and makes them mark a Stress. While Stunned, they can’t use reactions or take other actions until they clear the condition.

domainCards.name: Invisibility
domainCards.rules:
Make a Spellcast Roll (10). On a success, mark a Stress and choose yourself or an ally within Melee range to become Invisible. An Invisible creature can’t be seen except through magical means and attack rolls against them are made with disadvantage. Place a number of tokens on this card equal to your Spellcast trait. When the Invisible creature takes an action, spend a token from this card. After the action that spends the last token is resolved, the effect ends.
You can only hold Invisibility on one creature at a time.
domainCards.short:
Make a Spellcast Roll (10). On a success, mark a Stress and choose yourself or an ally within Melee range to become Invisible: they can’t be seen except through magic, and attack rolls against them have disadvantage. Place {{spellcast|# tokens|tokens equal to your Spellcast trait}} on this card; spend one when the Invisible creature takes an action. After the action that spends the last token, the effect ends.
You can hold Invisibility on only one creature at a time.

domainCards.name: Soothing Speech
domainCards.rules: During a short rest, when you take the time to comfort another character while using the Tend to Wounds downtime move on them, clear an additional Hit Point on that character. When you do, you also clear 2 Hit Points.
domainCards.short: During a short rest, when you comfort another character while using Tend to Wounds on them, clear an additional Hit Point on them. You also clear 2 Hit Points.

domainCards.name: Through Your Eyes
domainCards.rules: Choose a target within Very Far range. You can see through their eyes and hear through their ears. You can transition between using your own senses or the target’s freely until you cast another spell or until your next rest.
domainCards.short: Choose a target within Very Far range. You can see and hear through them, switching freely between your senses and theirs until you cast another spell or your next rest.

domainCards.name: Thought Delver
domainCards.rules:
You can peek into the minds of others. Spend a Hope to read the vague surface thoughts of a target within Far range. Make a Spellcast Roll against the target to delve for deeper, more hidden thoughts.
On a roll with Fear, the target might, at the GM’s discretion, become aware that you’re reading their thoughts.
domainCards.short:
Spend a Hope to read the vague surface thoughts of a target within Far range. Make a Spellcast Roll against the target to delve for deeper thoughts.
On a roll with Fear, the target might, at the GM’s discretion, become aware you’re reading their thoughts.

domainCards.name: Words of Discord
domainCards.rules:
Whisper words of discord to an adversary within Melee range and make a Spellcast Roll (13). On a success, the target must mark a Stress and make an attack against another adversary instead of against you or your allies.
Once this attack is over, the target realizes what happened. The next time you cast Words of Discord on them, gain a −5 penalty to the Spellcast Roll.
domainCards.short:
Whisper words of discord to an adversary within Melee range and make a Spellcast Roll (13). On a success, the target marks a Stress and attacks another adversary instead of you or your allies.
Afterward, the target realizes what happened; the next time you cast Words of Discord on them, gain a −5 penalty to the Spellcast Roll.

domainCards.name: Never Upstaged
domainCards.rules: When you mark 1 or more Hit Points from an attack, you can mark a Stress to place a number of tokens equal to the number of Hit Points you marked on this card. On your next successful attack, gain a +5 bonus to your damage roll for each token on this card, then clear all tokens.
domainCards.short: When you mark 1 or more Hit Points from an attack, mark a Stress to place tokens on this card equal to the Hit Points you marked. On your next successful attack, gain a +5 bonus to your damage roll for each token on this card, then clear all tokens.

domainCards.name: Share the Burden
domainCards.rules: Once per rest, take on the Stress from a willing creature within Melee range. The target describes what intimate knowledge or emotions telepathically leak from their mind in this moment between you. Transfer any number of their marked Stress to you, then gain a Hope for each Stress transferred.
domainCards.short: Once per rest, take on Stress from a willing creature within Melee range. They describe what intimate knowledge or emotions telepathically leak from their mind. Transfer any number of their marked Stress to you, then gain a Hope for each Stress transferred.

domainCards.name: Endless Charisma
domainCards.rules: After you make an action roll to persuade, lie, or garner favor, you can spend a Hope to reroll the Hope or Fear Die.
domainCards.short: After an action roll to persuade, lie, or garner favor, spend a Hope to reroll the Hope or Fear Die.

domainCards.name: Grace-Touched

When 4 or more of the domain cards in your loadout are from the Grace domain, gain the following benefits:
- You can mark an Armor Slot instead of marking a Stress.
- When you would force a target to mark a number of Hit Points, you can choose instead to force them to mark that number of Stress.
