When 4 or more loadout cards are from the Grace domain, gain:
- You can mark an Armor Slot instead of marking a Stress.
- When you would force a target to mark Hit Points, you can instead force them to mark that number of Stress.

domainCards.name: Astral Projection
domainCards.rules: Once per long rest, mark a Stress to create a projected copy of yourself that can appear anywhere you’ve been before. You can see and hear through the projection as though it were you and affect the world as though you were there. A creature investigating the projection can tell it’s of magical origin. This effect lasts until your next rest or your projection takes any damage.
domainCards.short: Once per long rest, mark a Stress to create a projected copy of yourself that can appear anywhere you’ve been before. You see and hear through it and affect the world as though you were there. A creature investigating it can tell it’s magical. This lasts until your next rest or the projection takes any damage.

domainCards.name: Mass Enrapture
domainCards.rules: Make a Spellcast Roll against all targets within Far range. Targets you succeed against become temporarily Enraptured. While Enraptured, a target’s attention is fixed on you, narrowing their field of view and drowning out any sound but your voice. Mark a Stress to force all Enraptured targets to mark a Stress, ending this spell.
domainCards.short: Make a Spellcast Roll against all targets within Far range. Targets you succeed against become temporarily Enraptured: their attention is fixed on you, narrowing their view and drowning out all sound but your voice. Mark a Stress to force all Enraptured targets to mark a Stress, ending this spell.

domainCards.name: Copycat
domainCards.rules: Once per long rest, this card can mimic the features of another domain card of level 8 or lower in another player’s loadout. Spend Hope equal to half the card’s level to gain access to the feature. It lasts until your next rest or they place the card in their vault.
domainCards.short: Once per long rest, this card can mimic the features of another domain card of level 8 or lower in another player’s loadout. Spend Hope equal to half its level to gain the feature, until your next rest or they vault the card.

domainCards.name: Master of the Craft
domainCards.rules: Gain a permanent +2 bonus to two of your Experiences or a permanent +3 bonus to one of your Experiences. Then place this card in your vault permanently.
domainCards.short: Gain a permanent +2 bonus to two of your Experiences or a permanent +3 bonus to one. Then place this card in your vault permanently.

domainCards.name: Encore
domainCards.rules: When an ally within Close range deals damage to an adversary, you can make a Spellcast Roll against that same target. On a success, you deal the same damage to the target that your ally dealt. If your Spellcast Roll succeeds with Fear, place this card in your vault.
domainCards.short: When an ally within Close range deals damage to an adversary, make a Spellcast Roll against the same target. On a success, deal the same damage to it. If the roll succeeds with Fear, place this card in your vault.

domainCards.name: Notorious
domainCards.rules: People know who you are and what you’ve done, and they treat you differently because of it. When you leverage your notoriety to get what you want, you can mark a Stress before you roll to gain a +10 bonus to the result. Your food and drinks are always free wherever you go, and everything else you buy is reduced in price by one bag of gold (to a minimum of one handful).
domainCards.short: People know who you are and what you’ve done. When you leverage your notoriety to get what you want, mark a Stress before you roll to gain a +10 bonus to the result. Your food and drinks are always free, and everything else you buy is reduced in price by one bag of gold (to a minimum of one handful).

domainCards.name: Pick and Pull
domainCards.rules: You have advantage on action rolls to pick nonmagical locks, disarm nonmagical traps, or steal items from a target (either through stealth or by force).
domainCards.short: Gain advantage on action rolls to pick nonmagical locks, disarm nonmagical traps, or steal items from a target (by stealth or force).

domainCards.name: Rain of Blades
domainCards.rules:
Spend a Hope to make a Spellcast Roll and conjure throwing blades that strike out at all targets within Very Close range. Targets you succeed against take d8+2 magic damage using your Proficiency.
If a target you hit is Vulnerable, they take an extra 1d8 damage.
domainCards.short:
Spend a Hope to make a Spellcast Roll and conjure throwing blades that strike all targets within Very Close range. Targets you succeed against take {{proficiency|#d8+2 magic damage|d8+2 magic damage using your Proficiency}}.
A Vulnerable target you hit takes an extra 1d8 damage.

domainCards.name: Uncanny Disguise
domainCards.rules:
When you have a few minutes to prepare, you can mark a Stress to don the facade of any humanoid you can picture clearly in your mind. While disguised, you have advantage on Presence Rolls to avoid scrutiny.
Place a number of tokens equal to your Spellcast trait on this card. When you take an action while disguised, spend a token from this card. After the action that spends the last token is resolved, the disguise drops.
domainCards.short:
When you have a few minutes to prepare, mark a Stress to don the facade of any humanoid you can picture clearly. While disguised, you have advantage on Presence Rolls to avoid scrutiny.
Place {{spellcast|# tokens|tokens equal to your Spellcast trait}} on this card; spend one when you take an action while disguised. After the action that spends the last token, the disguise drops.

domainCards.name: Midnight Spirit
domainCards.rules:
Spend a Hope to summon a humanoid - sized spirit that can move or carry things for you until your next rest.
You can also send it to attack an adversary. When you do, make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Very Far range. On a success, the spirit moves into Melee range with that target. Roll a number of d6s equal to your Spellcast trait and deal that much magic damage to the target. The spirit then dissipates. You can only have one spirit at a time.
domainCards.short:
Spend a Hope to summon a humanoid-sized spirit that can move or carry things for you until your next rest.
You can also send it to attack: make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Very Far range. On a success, the spirit moves into Melee range with the target, and you roll {{spellcast|#d6|a number of d6s equal to your Spellcast trait}} and deal that much magic damage. The spirit then dissipates. You can have only one spirit at a time.

domainCards.name: Shadowbind
domainCards.rules: Make a Spellcast Roll against all adversaries within Very Close range. Targets you succeed against are temporarily Restrained as their shadow binds them in place.
domainCards.short: Make a Spellcast Roll against all adversaries within Very Close range. Targets you succeed against are temporarily Restrained as their shadow binds them in place.

domainCards.name: Chokehold
domainCards.rules:
When you position yourself behind a creature who’s about your size, you can mark a Stress to pull them into a chokehold, making them temporarily Vulnerable.
When a creature attacks a target who is Vulnerable in this way, they deal an extra 2d6 damage.
domainCards.short:
When you position yourself behind a creature about your size, mark a Stress to pull them into a chokehold, making them temporarily Vulnerable.
When a creature attacks a target Vulnerable this way, they deal an extra 2d6 damage.

domainCards.name: Veil of Night
domainCards.rules: Make a Spellcast Roll (13). On a success, you can create a temporary curtain of darkness between two points within Far range. Only you can see through this darkness. You’re considered Hidden to adversaries on the other side of the veil, and you have advantage on attacks you make through the darkness. The veil remains until you cast another spell.
domainCards.short: Make a Spellcast Roll (13). On a success, create a temporary curtain of darkness between two points within Far range. Only you can see through it. You’re Hidden to adversaries on the other side and have advantage on attacks you make through it. It remains until you cast another spell.

domainCards.name: Stealth Expertise
domainCards.rules:
When you roll with Fear while attempting to move unnoticed through a dangerous area, you can mark a Stress to roll with Hope instead.
If an ally within Close range is also attempting to move unnoticed and rolls with Fear, you can mark a Stress to change their result to a roll with Hope.
domainCards.short:
When you roll with Fear while trying to move unnoticed through a dangerous area, mark a Stress to roll with Hope instead.
If an ally within Close range is also moving unnoticed and rolls with Fear, mark a Stress to change their result to a roll with Hope.

domainCards.name: Glyph of Nightfall
domainCards.rules: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Very Close range. On a success, spend a Hope to conjure a dark glyph upon their body that exposes their weak points, temporarily reducing the target’s Difficulty by a value equal to your Knowledge (minimum 1).
domainCards.short: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Very Close range. On a success, spend a Hope to conjure a dark glyph on their body that exposes their weak points, temporarily reducing their Difficulty by {{knowledgeMin1|#|a value equal to your Knowledge (minimum 1)}}.

domainCards.name: Hush
domainCards.rules:
Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Close range. On a success, spend a Hope to conjure suppressive magic around the target that encompasses everything within Very Close range of them and follows them as they move.
The target and anything within the area is Silenced until the GM spends a Fear on their turn to clear this condition, you cast Hush again, or you take Major damage. While Silenced, they can’t make noise and can’t cast spells.
domainCards.short:
Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Close range. On a success, spend a Hope to conjure suppressive magic around the target, covering everything within Very Close range of them and following them as they move.
The target and anything in the area is Silenced until the GM spends a Fear on their turn to clear it, you cast Hush again, or you take Major damage. While Silenced, they can’t make noise or cast spells.

domainCards.name: Phantom Retreat
domainCards.rules: Spend a Hope to activate Phantom Retreat where you’re currently standing. Spend another Hope at any time before your next rest to disappear from where you are and reappear where you were standing when you activated Phantom Retreat. This spell ends after you reappear.
domainCards.short: Spend a Hope to activate Phantom Retreat where you stand. Spend another Hope any time before your next rest to disappear and reappear where you activated it. The spell ends after you reappear.

domainCards.name: Dark Whispers
domainCards.rules:
You can speak into the mind of any person with whom you’ve made physical contact. Once you’ve opened a channel with them, they can speak back into your mind. Additionally, you can mark a Stress to make a Spellcast Roll against them. On a success, you can ask the GM one of the following questions and receive an answer:
- Where are they?
- What are they doing?
- What are they afraid of?
- What do they cherish most in the world?
domainCards.short:
Speak into the mind of anyone you’ve made physical contact with; once a channel is open, they can speak back. You can also mark a Stress to make a Spellcast Roll against them. On a success, ask the GM one of these questions and receive an answer:
- Where are they?
- What are they doing?
- What are they afraid of?
- What do they cherish most in the world?

domainCards.name: Mass Disguise
domainCards.rules:
When you have a few minutes of silence to focus, you can mark a Stress to change the appearance of all willing creatures within Close range. Their new forms must share a general body structure and size, and can be somebody or something you’ve seen before or entirely fabricated. A disguised creature has advantage on Presence Rolls to avoid scrutiny.
Activate a Countdown (8). It ticks down as a consequence the GM chooses. When it triggers, the disguise drops.
domainCards.short:
With a few minutes of silence to focus, mark a Stress to change the appearance of all willing creatures within Close range. New forms must share a general body structure and size, and can be someone or something you’ve seen or entirely fabricated. A disguised creature has advantage on Presence Rolls to avoid scrutiny.
Activate a Countdown (8), ticking down as a consequence the GM chooses. When it triggers, the disguise drops.

domainCards.name: Midnight-Touched
domainCards.rules:
When 4 or more of the domain cards in your loadout are from the Midnight domain, gain the following benefits:
- Once per rest, when you have 0 Hope and the GM would gain a Fear, you can gain a Hope instead.
- When you make a successful attack, you can mark a Stress to add the result of your Fear Die to your damage roll.
domainCards.short:
When 4 or more loadout cards are from the Midnight domain, gain:
- Once per rest, when you have 0 Hope and the GM would gain a Fear, gain a Hope instead.
- When you make a successful attack, mark a Stress to add the result of your Fear Die to your damage roll.

domainCards.name: Vanishing Dodge
domainCards.rules: When an attack made against you that would deal physical damage fails, you can spend a Hope to envelop yourself in shadow, becoming Hidden and teleporting to a point within Close range of the attacker. You remain Hidden until the next time you make an action roll.
domainCards.short: When an attack against you that would deal physical damage fails, spend a Hope to envelop yourself in shadow, becoming Hidden and teleporting to a point within Close range of the attacker. You stay Hidden until your next action roll.

domainCards.name: Shadowhunter
domainCards.rules: Your prowess is enhanced under the cover of shadow. While you’re shrouded in low light or darkness, you gain a +1 bonus to your Evasion and make attack rolls with advantage.
domainCards.short: While shrouded in low light or darkness, gain a +1 bonus to your Evasion and make attack rolls with advantage.

statNote.text: +1 Evasion while shrouded in low light or darkness.

domainCards.name: Spellcharge
domainCards.rules:
When you take magic damage, place tokens equal to the number of Hit Points you marked on this card. You can store a number of tokens equal to your Spellcast trait.
When you make a successful attack against a target, you can spend any number of tokens to add a d6 for each token spent to your damage roll.
domainCards.short:
When you take magic damage, place tokens equal to the Hit Points you marked on this card, up to {{spellcast|#|your Spellcast trait}}.
When you succeed on an attack, spend any number of tokens to add a d6 per token to your damage roll.

domainCards.name: Night Terror
domainCards.rules: Once per long rest, choose any targets within Very Close range to perceive you as a nightmarish horror. The targets must succeed on a Reaction Roll (16) or become temporarily Horrified. While Horrified, they’re Vulnerable. Steal a number of Fear from the GM equal to the number of targets that are Horrified (up to the number of Fear in the GM’s pool). Roll a number of d6s equal to the number of stolen Fear and deal the total damage to each Horrified target. Discard the stolen Fear.
domainCards.short: Once per long rest, choose any targets within Very Close range to perceive you as a nightmarish horror. They must succeed on a Reaction Roll (16) or become temporarily Horrified, making them Vulnerable. Steal Fear from the GM equal to the number of Horrified targets (up to the Fear in the GM’s pool), roll that many d6s, deal the total to each Horrified target, and discard the stolen Fear.

domainCards.name: Twilight Toll
domainCards.rules:
Choose a target within Far range. When you succeed on an action roll against them that doesn’t result in making a damage roll, place a token on this card. When you deal damage to this target, spend any number of tokens to add a d12 for each token spent to your damage roll. You can only hold Twilight Toll on one creature at a time.
When you choose a new target or take a rest, clear all unspent tokens.
domainCards.short:
Choose a target within Far range. When you succeed on an action roll against them that doesn’t result in a damage roll, place a token on this card. When you deal damage to this target, spend any number of tokens to add a d12 per token to your damage roll. You can hold Twilight Toll on only one creature at a time.
When you choose a new target or take a rest, clear unspent tokens.

domainCards.name: Eclipse
domainCards.rules:
Make a Spellcast Roll (16). Once per long rest on a success, plunge the entire area within Far range into complete darkness only you and your allies can see through. Attack rolls have disadvantage when targeting you or an ally within this shadow. Additionally, when you or an ally succeeds with Hope against an adversary within this shadow, the target must mark a Stress.
This spell lasts until the GM spends a Fear on their turn to clear this effect or you take Severe damage.
domainCards.short:
Make a Spellcast Roll (16). Once per long rest on a success, plunge everything within Far range into complete darkness that only you and your allies can see through. Attack rolls against you or an ally in the shadow have disadvantage, and when you or an ally succeeds with Hope against an adversary in it, the target marks a Stress.
This lasts until the GM spends a Fear on their turn to clear it or you take Severe damage.

domainCards.name: Specter of the Dark
domainCards.rules: Mark a Stress to become Spectral until you make an action roll targeting another creature. While Spectral, you’re immune to physical damage and can float and pass through solid objects. Other creatures can still see you while you’re in this form.
domainCards.short: Mark a Stress to become Spectral until you make an action roll targeting another creature. While Spectral, you’re immune to physical damage and can float and pass through solid objects. Other creatures can still see you.

domainCards.name: Gifted Tracker
domainCards.rules:
When you’re tracking a specific creature or group of creatures based on signs of their passage, you can spend any number of Hope and ask the GM that many questions from the following list.
- What direction did they go?
- How long ago did they pass through?
- What were they doing in this location?
- How many of them were here?
When you encounter creatures you’ve tracked in this way, gain a +1 bonus to your Evasion against them.
domainCards.short:
When tracking a specific creature or group by signs of their passage, spend any number of Hope and ask the GM that many questions:
- What direction did they go?
- How long ago did they pass through?
- What were they doing in this location?
- How many of them were here?
When you encounter creatures tracked this way, gain a +1 bonus to your Evasion against them.

domainCards.name: Nature’s Tongue
domainCards.rules:
You can speak the language of the natural world. When you want to speak to the plants and animals around you, make an Instinct Roll (12). On a success, they’ll give you the information they know. On a roll with Fear, their knowledge might be limited or come at a cost.
Additionally, before you make a Spellcast Roll while within a natural environment, you can spend a Hope to gain a +2 bonus to the roll.
domainCards.short:
Speak the language of the natural world: to talk to nearby plants and animals, make an Instinct Roll (12). On a success, they give you the information they know; on a roll with Fear, their knowledge might be limited or come at a cost.
Before a Spellcast Roll in a natural environment, spend a Hope to gain a +2 bonus to the roll.

domainCards.name: Vicious Entangle
domainCards.rules: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Far range. On a success, roots and vines reach out from the ground, dealing 1d8+1 physical damage and temporarily Restraining the target. Additionally on a success, you can spend a Hope to temporarily Restrain another adversary within Very Close range of your target.
domainCards.short: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Far range. On a success, roots and vines deal 1d8+1 physical damage and temporarily Restrain the target. Also on a success, spend a Hope to temporarily Restrain another adversary within Very Close range of your target.

domainCards.name: Conjure Swarm
domainCards.rules:
Tekaira Armored Beetles: Mark a Stress to conjure armored beetles that encircle you. When you next take damage, reduce the severity by one threshold. You can spend a Hope to keep the beetles conjured after taking damage.
Fire Flies: Make a Spellcast Roll against all adversaries within Close range. Spend a Hope to deal 2d8+3 magic damage to targets you succeeded against.
domainCards.short:
Tekaira Armored Beetles: Mark a Stress to conjure armored beetles that encircle you. When you next take damage, reduce the severity by one threshold. Spend a Hope to keep the beetles after taking damage.
Fire Flies: Make a Spellcast Roll against all adversaries within Close range. Spend a Hope to deal 2d8+3 magic damage to targets you succeeded against.

domainCards.name: Natural Familiar
domainCards.rules:
Spend a Hope to summon a small nature spirit or forest critter to your side until your next rest, you cast Natural Familiar again, or the familiar is targeted by an attack. If you spend an additional Hope, you can summon a familiar that flies. You can communicate with them, make a Spellcast Roll to command them to perform simple tasks, and mark a Stress to see through their eyes.
When you deal damage to an adversary within Melee range of your familiar, you add a d6 to your damage roll.
domainCards.short:
Spend a Hope to summon a small nature spirit or forest critter until your next rest, you cast Natural Familiar again, or it’s targeted by an attack. Spend an additional Hope for one that flies. You can communicate with it, make a Spellcast Roll to command simple tasks, and mark a Stress to see through its eyes.
When you deal damage to an adversary within Melee range of your familiar, add a d6 to your damage roll.

domainCards.name: Corrosive Projectile
domainCards.rules: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Far range. On a success, deal d6+4 magic damage using your Proficiency. Additionally, mark 2 or more Stress to make them permanently Corroded. While a target is Corroded, they gain a −1 penalty to their Difficulty for every 2 Stress you spent. This condition can stack.
domainCards.short: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Far range. On a success, deal {{proficiency|#d6+4 magic damage|d6+4 magic damage using your Proficiency}}. Also mark 2 or more Stress to make them permanently Corroded: they gain a −1 penalty to Difficulty for every 2 Stress you spent. This condition can stack.

domainCards.name: Towering Stalk
domainCards.rules:
Once per rest, you can conjure a thick, twisting stalk within Close range that can be easily climbed. Its height can grow up to Far range.
Mark a Stress to use this spell as an attack. Make a Spellcast Roll against an adversary or group of adversaries within Close range. The erupting stalk lifts targets you succeed against into the air and drops them, dealing d8 physical damage using your Proficiency.
domainCards.short:
Once per rest, conjure a thick, twisting stalk within Close range that is easily climbed, growing up to Far range.
Mark a Stress to use it as an attack: make a Spellcast Roll against an adversary or group within Close range. The erupting stalk lifts targets you succeed against into the air and drops them for {{proficiency|#d8 physical damage|d8 physical damage using your Proficiency}}.

domainCards.name: Death Grip
domainCards.rules:
Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Close range and choose one of the following options:
- You pull the target into Melee range or pull yourself into Melee range of them.
- You constrict the target and force them to mark 2 Stress.
- All adversaries between you and the target must succeed on a Reaction Roll (13) or be hit by vines, taking 3d6+2 physical damage.
On a success, vines reach out from your hands, causing the chosen effect and temporarily Restraining the target.
domainCards.short:
Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Close range and choose one option:
- Pull the target into Melee range, or pull yourself into Melee range of them.
- Constrict the target, forcing them to mark 2 Stress.
- All adversaries between you and the target must succeed on a Reaction Roll (13) or be hit by vines for 3d6+2 physical damage.
On a success, vines reach out from your hands, causing the chosen effect and temporarily Restraining the target.

domainCards.name: Healing Field
domainCards.rules:
Once per long rest, you can conjure a field of healing plants around you. Everywhere within Close range of you bursts to life with vibrant nature, allowing you and all allies in the area to clear a Hit Point.
Spend 2 Hope to allow you and all allies to clear 2 Hit Points instead.
domainCards.short:
Once per long rest, conjure a field of healing plants around you. Everywhere within Close range bursts with vibrant nature, letting you and all allies in the area clear a Hit Point.
Spend 2 Hope to have you and all allies clear 2 Hit Points instead.

domainCards.name: Thorn Skin
domainCards.rules:
Once per rest, spend a Hope to sprout thorns all over your body. When you do, place a number of tokens equal to your Spellcast trait on this card. When you take damage, you can spend any number of tokens to roll that number of d6s. Add the results together and reduce the incoming damage by that amount. If you’re within Melee range of the attacker, deal that amount of damage back to them.
When you take a rest, clear all unspent tokens.
domainCards.short:
Once per rest, spend a Hope to sprout thorns all over your body, placing {{spellcast|# tokens|tokens equal to your Spellcast trait}} on this card. When you take damage, spend any number of tokens to roll that many d6s and reduce the damage by the total. If you’re within Melee range of the attacker, deal that much damage back.
When you take a rest, clear unspent tokens.

domainCards.name: Wild Fortress
domainCards.rules:
Make a Spellcast Roll (13). On a success, spend 2 Hope to grow a natural barricade in the shape of a dome that you and one ally can take cover within. While inside the dome, a creature can’t be targeted by attacks and can’t make attacks. Attacks made against the dome automatically succeed. The dome has the following damage thresholds and lasts until it marks 3 Hit Points. Place tokens on this card to represent marking Hit Points.
Thresholds: 15/30
domainCards.short:
Make a Spellcast Roll (13). On a success, spend 2 Hope to grow a dome-shaped natural barricade that you and one ally can take cover in. Creatures inside can’t be targeted by attacks or make attacks. Attacks against the dome automatically succeed. It has the thresholds below and lasts until it marks 3 Hit Points; place tokens on this card to mark them.
Thresholds: 15/30

domainCards.name: Conjured Steeds
domainCards.rules: Spend any number of Hope to conjure that many magical steeds (such as horses, camels, or elephants) that you and your allies can ride until your next long rest or the steeds take any damage. The steeds double your land speed while traveling and, when in danger, allow you to move within Far range without having to roll. Creatures riding a steed gain a −2 penalty to attack rolls and a +2 bonus to damage rolls.
domainCards.short: Spend any number of Hope to conjure that many magical steeds (such as horses, camels, or elephants) that you and your allies can ride until your next long rest or they take any damage. They double your land speed while traveling and, in danger, let you move within Far range without rolling. Riders gain a −2 penalty to attack rolls and a +2 bonus to damage rolls.

domainCards.name: Forager
domainCards.rules:
As an additional downtime move you can choose, roll a d6 to see what you forage. Work with the GM to describe it and add it to your inventory as a consumable. Your party can carry up to five foraged consumables at a time.
1. A unique food (Clear 2 Stress)
2. A beautiful relic (Gain 2 Hope)
3. An arcane rune (+2 to a Spellcast Roll) 4. A healing vial (Clear 2 Hit Points)
5. A luck charm (Reroll any die)
6. Choose one of the options above.
domainCards.short: As an additional downtime move, roll a d6 to see what you forage. Work with the GM to describe it and add it to your inventory as a consumable. Your party can carry up to five foraged consumables at a time.

domainCards.name: Sage-Touched
domainCards.rules:
When 4 or more of the domain cards in your loadout are from the Sage domain, gain the following benefits:
- While you’re in a natural environment, you gain a +2 bonus to your Spellcast Rolls.
- Once per rest, you can double your Agility or Instinct when making a roll that uses that trait. You must choose to do this before you roll.
domainCards.short:
When 4 or more loadout cards are from the Sage domain, gain:
- In a natural environment, a +2 bonus to your Spellcast Rolls.
- Once per rest, double your Agility or Instinct when making a roll that uses that trait (choose before you roll).

domainCards.name: Wild Surge
domainCards.rules:
Once per long rest, mark a Stress to channel the natural world around you and enhance yourself. Describe how your appearance changes, then place a d6 on this card with the 1 value facing up.
While the Wild Surge Die is active, you add its value to every action roll you make. After you add its value to a roll, increase the Wild Surge Die’s value by one. When the die’s value would exceed 6 or you take a rest, this form drops and you must mark an additional Stress.
domainCards.short:
Once per long rest, mark a Stress to channel the natural world and enhance yourself. Describe how your appearance changes, then place a d6 on this card with the 1 facing up.
While the Wild Surge Die is active, add its value to every action roll you make, then increase it by one. When its value would exceed 6 or you take a rest, the form drops and you mark an additional Stress.

domainCards.name: Forest Sprites
domainCards.rules:
Make a Spellcast Roll (13). On a success, spend any number of Hope to create an equal number of small forest sprites who appear at points you choose within Far range, providing the following benefits:
- Your allies gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls against adversaries within Melee range of a sprite.
- An ally who marks an Armor Slot while within Melee range of a sprite can mark an additional Armor Slot.
A sprite vanishes after granting a benefit or taking any damage.
domainCards.short:
Make a Spellcast Roll (13). On a success, spend any number of Hope to create that many small forest sprites at points you choose within Far range, granting:
- Your allies gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls against adversaries within Melee range of a sprite.
- An ally who marks an Armor Slot within Melee range of a sprite can mark an additional Armor Slot.
A sprite vanishes after granting a benefit or taking any damage.

domainCards.name: Rejuvenation Barrier
domainCards.rules:
Make a Spellcast Roll (15). Once per rest on a success, create a temporary barrier of protective energy around you at Very Close range. You and all allies within the barrier when this spell is cast clear 1d4 Hit Points. While the barrier is up, you and all allies within have resistance to physical damage from outside the barrier.
When you move, the barrier follows you.
domainCards.short:

equipment.name: Rune-Forged Exosuit

equipment.name: Dunamis Silkchain

equipment.name: Hallowed Heroplate

equipment.name: Resonant Harness
equipment.feature: Vitreous: When you would take Severe or greater damage, you can mark 2 Armor Slots to negate that damage. If you do, you gain a −5 penalty to your damage thresholds until you choose to repair your armor as a downtime move.

equipment.name: Savior Chainmail
equipment.feature: Difficult: −1 to all character traits and Evasion

equipment.name: Varik Leaves

equipment.name: Vial of Moondrip
equipment.rules: When you drink the contents of this vial, you can see in total darkness until your next rest.

equipment.name: Unstable Arcane Shard
equipment.rules: You can make a Finesse Roll to throw this shard at a group of adversaries within Far range. Targets you succeed against take 1d20 magic damage.

equipment.name: Potion of Stability
equipment.rules: You can drink this potion to choose one additional downtime move.

equipment.name: Improved Grindletooth Venom
equipment.rules: You can apply this venom to a weapon that deals physical damage to add a d8 to your next damage roll with that weapon.

equipment.name: Morphing Clay
equipment.rules: You can spend a Hope to use this clay, altering your face enough to make you unrecognizable until your next rest.

equipment.name: Vial of Darksmoke
equipment.rules: When an adversary attacks you, use this vial and roll a number of d6s equal to your Agility. Add the highest result to your Evasion against the attack.

statNote.text: Roll d6s equal to Agility; add the highest to Evasion against one attack.

equipment.name: Jumping Root
equipment.rules: Eat this root to leap up to Far range once without needing to roll.

equipment.name: Snap Powder
equipment.rules: Mark a Stress and clear a HP.

equipment.name: Health Potion
equipment.rules: Clear 1d4+1 HP.

equipment.name: Stamina Potion
equipment.rules: Clear 1d4+1 Stress.

equipment.name: Armor Stitcher
equipment.rules: You can use this stitcher to spend any number of Hope and clear that many Armor Slots.

equipment.name: Gill Salve
equipment.rules: You can apply this salve to your neck to breathe underwater for a number of minutes equal to your level.

equipment.name: Replication Parchment
equipment.rules: By touching this piece of parchment to another, you can perfectly copy the second parchment’s contents. Once used, this parchment becomes mundane paper.

equipment.name: Improved Arcane Shard
equipment.rules: You can make a Finesse Roll to throw this shard at a group of adversaries within Far range. Targets you succeed against take 2d20 magic damage.

equipment.name: Major Stride Potion
equipment.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to your Agility until your next rest.

equipment.name: Major Bolster Potion
equipment.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to your Strength until your next rest.

equipment.name: Major Control Potion
equipment.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to your Finesse until your next rest.

equipment.name: Major Attune Potion
equipment.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to your Instinct until your next rest.

equipment.name: Major Charm Potion
equipment.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to your Presence until your next rest.

equipment.name: Major Enlighten Potion
equipment.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to your Knowledge until your next rest.

equipment.name: Blood of the Yorgi
equipment.rules: You can drink this blood to disappear from where you are and immediately reappear at a point you can see within Very Far range.

equipment.name: Homet’s Secret Potion
equipment.rules: After drinking this potion, the next successful attack you make critically succeeds.

equipment.name: Redthorn Saliva
equipment.rules: You can apply this saliva to a weapon that deals physical damage to add a d12 to your next damage roll with that weapon.

equipment.name: Channelstone
equipment.rules: You can use this stone to take a spell or grimoire from your vault, use it once, and return it to your vault.

equipment.name: Mythic Dust
equipment.rules: You can apply this dust to a weapon that deals magic damage to add a d12 to your next damage roll with that weapon.

equipment.name: Acidpaste
equipment.rules: This paste eats away walls and other surfaces in bright flashes.

equipment.name: Hopehold Flare
equipment.rules: When you use this flare, allies within Close range roll a d6 when they spend a Hope. On a result of 6, they gain the effect of that Hope without spending it. The flare lasts until the end of the scene.

equipment.name: Major Arcane Shard
equipment.rules: You can make a Finesse Roll to throw this shard at a group of adversaries within Far range. Targets you succeed against take 4d20 magic damage.

equipment.name: Featherbone
equipment.rules: You can use this bone to control your falling speed for a number of minutes equal to your level.

equipment.name: Circle of the Void
equipment.rules: Mark a Stress to create a void that extends up to Far range. No magic can be cast inside the void, and creatures within the void are immune to magic damage.

equipment.name: Sun Tree Sap
equipment.rules: Consume this sap to roll a d6. On a result of 5–6, clear 2 HP. On a result of 2–4, clear 3 Stress. On a result of 1, see through the veil of death and return changed, gaining one scar.

equipment.name: Dripfang Poison
equipment.rules: A creature who consumes this poison takes 8d10 direct magic damage.

equipment.name: Major Health Potion
equipment.rules: Clear 1d4+2 HP.

equipment.name: Major Stamina Potion
equipment.rules: Clear 1d4+2 Stress.

equipment.name: Ogre Musk
equipment.rules: You can use this musk to prevent anyone from tracking you by mundane or magical means until your next rest.

equipment.name: Wingsprout
equipment.rules: You gain magic wings that allow you to fly for a number of minutes equal to your level.

equipment.name: Jar of Lost Voices
equipment.rules: You can open this jar to release a deafening echo of voices for a number of minutes equal to your Instinct. Creatures within Far range unprepared for the sound take 6d8 magic damage.

equipment.name: Dragonbloom Tea
equipment.rules: You can drink this tea to unleash a fiery breath attack. Make an Instinct Roll against all adversaries in front of you within Close range. Targets you succeed against take d20 physical damage using your Proficiency.

equipment.name: Bridge Seed
equipment.rules: Thick vines grow from your location to a point of your choice within Far range, allowing you to climb up or across them. The vines dissipate on your next short rest.

equipment.name: Sleeping Sap
equipment.rules: You can drink this potion to fall asleep for a full night’s rest. You clear all Stress upon waking.

equipment.name: Feast of Xuria
equipment.rules: You can eat this meal to clear all HP and Stress and gain 1d4 Hope.

equipment.name: Bonding Honey
equipment.rules: This honey can be used to glue two objects together permanently.

equipment.name: Shrinking Potion
equipment.rules: You can drink this potion to halve your size until you choose to drop this form or your next rest. While in this form, you have a +2 bonus to Agility and a −1 penalty to your Proficiency.

equipment.name: Growing Potion
equipment.rules: You can drink this potion to double your size until you choose to drop this form or your next rest. While in this form, you have a +2 bonus to Strength and a +1 bonus to your Proficiency.

equipment.name: Knowledge Stone
equipment.rules: If you die while holding this stone, an ally can take a card from your loadout to place in their loadout or vault. After they take this knowledge, the stone crumbles.

equipment.name: Sweet Moss
equipment.rules: You can consume this moss during a rest to clear 1d10 HP or 1d10 Stress.

equipment.name: Blinding Orb
equipment.rules: You can activate this orb to create a flash of bright light. All targets within Close range become Vulnerable until they mark HP.

equipment.name: Death Tea
equipment.rules: After you drink this tea, you instantly kill your target when you critically succeed on an attack. If you don’t critically succeed on an attack before your next long rest, you die.

equipment.name: Mirror of Marigold
equipment.rules: When you take damage, you can spend a Hope to negate that damage, after which the mirror shatters.

equipment.name: Stardrop
equipment.rules: You can use this stardrop to summon a hailstorm of comets that deals 8d20 physical damage to all targets within Very Far range.

equipment.name: Warding Candle
equipment.rules: You can light this candle to fill an area within Close range with a halo of light. A creature outside the halo can’t enter it if they have ill intent toward a creature within it. The candle burns for an hour.

equipment.name: Iridian Dust
equipment.rules: This multicolored powder sticks to everything and prevents creatures covered in it from becoming Hidden.

equipment.name: Verglasian Seed
equipment.rules: You can use this ice shard to instantly freeze an area of water up to Close range.

equipment.name: Cupbearer’s Bezoar
equipment.rules: You can swallow this bezoar to become immune to poisons until your next long rest.

equipment.name: Mossmantle Potion
equipment.rules: You can drink this tea to perfectly blend into natural environments until your next rest.

equipment.name: Lyrebird Lozenge
equipment.rules: You can dissolve this lozenge in your mouth to perfectly mimic any voice you’ve heard until the end of the scene.

equipment.name: Vial of Featherfall
equipment.rules: You can drink this potion to ignore damage from falling for the next 10 minutes.

equipment.name: Chimeric Saliva
equipment.rules: You can apply this saliva to a weapon that deals physical damage to change its damage type to magic until your next rest.

equipment.name: Packet of Space Dust
equipment.rules: This dust causes anything it covers to become lighter than air. One packet contains enough dust to cover the contents of a picnic basket, and the effects last for an hour.

equipment.name: Pipeweed
equipment.rules: When you choose the Clear Stress downtime move during a short rest, you can smoke this non-intoxicating leaf to clear an additional Stress. Any other PCs who chose the Clear Stress downtime move also gain this benefit.

equipment.name: Deathseer’s Powder
equipment.rules: You can sprinkle this powder over a recently deceased corpse to conjure a spectral reprise of their final minute of life.

equipment.name: Slayer’s Salt
equipment.rules: You can spread this salt in a line along windowsills or thresholds to create a magical barrier that undead creatures can’t cross until the line is broken.

equipment.name: Yakamel Milk
equipment.rules: After consuming this milk, the next time you clear 1 or more Hit Points, you clear an additional Hit Point.

equipment.name: Glowmoss Mushroom
equipment.rules: You can break this mushroom into pieces, causing it to glow bright blue until your next long rest.

equipment.name: Red Ooze Oil
equipment.rules: You can coat your weapon in this oil. The next successful attack you make with this weapon deals an extra 1d8 magic damage and temporarily Ignites the target. While Ignited, the target takes 1d4 magic damage when they take the spotlight.

equipment.name: Instant Camp
equipment.rules: You can unfold this small mechanical box into a camping tent large enough to safely house six people. The tent collapses at the end of your next long rest.

equipment.name: Bundle of Spiderlegs
equipment.rules: You can eat these spiderlegs to walk on walls until your next rest.

equipment.name: Ciscan Fog Bottle
equipment.rules: You can break this jar to fill the area within Close range with magical mist. A creature who enters the mist clears a Stress and becomes Hidden.

equipment.name: Snapthorn Seed
equipment.rules: You can throw this seed at a point you can see. It explodes into a tangle of binding vines that temporarily Restrains all creatures within Close range of that point.

equipment.name: Sprite Bottle
equipment.rules: When you mark your last Hit Point, this bottle shatters to release the Sprite inside. The Sprite clears all your Hit Points before fading from the Mortal Realm.

equipment.name: Gravity Bomb
equipment.rules: You can throw this peach-sized mechanical orb at a point within Far range. It implodes and pulls all creatures and objects within Close range of that point into Melee range with it.

equipment.name: Gossip Flower
equipment.rules: You can plant this seed in soil. It instantly grows into a small flower that records everything it hears for up to one week. When plucked, the flower recites what it recorded in real time, then withers.

equipment.name: Displacement Token
equipment.rules: You can swallow this token to conjure two illusions of yourself that you can control. Each illusion lasts until it takes damage or until your next rest.

equipment.name: Night Hag’s Dust
equipment.rules: You can blow this dust in an adversary’s face to prevent them from clearing Stress until your next long rest.

equipment.name: Self-Sewing Thread
equipment.rules: You can use this thread to clear either a Hit Point or 2 Armor Slots.

equipment.name: Stonemason’s Fortune
equipment.rules: When you throw this gray brick on the ground, it immediately grows into a 6-foot-tall, 10-foot-wide, and 2-foot- deep wall of solid stone.

equipment.name: Mnemonic Potion
equipment.rules: You can drink this potion to Utilize an Experience without spending a Hope.

equipment.name: Salamander Salve
equipment.rules: You can apply this salve to your skin to make yourself immune to heat until your next rest.

equipment.name: Green Ooze Oil
equipment.rules: You can coat your weapon in this oil. The next successful attack you make with this weapon deals an extra 1d8 magic damage and temporarily Corrodes the target. While Corroded, the target gains a −2 penalty to their damage thresholds.

equipment.name: Sunlight Orb
equipment.rules: You can shatter this orb to make the area within Very Far range appear as though it’s sunlit daytime for the next 24 hours.

equipment.name: Moonlight Orb
equipment.rules: You can shatter this orb to make the area within Very Far range appear as though it’s moonlit nighttime for the next 24 hours.

equipment.name: Midas Flask
equipment.rules: You can pour this small flask of alchemical liquid over a mundane item to instantly transmute it into a handful of gold.

equipment.name: Staff of Reversal
equipment.rules: You can break this staff against the ground to reverse one magical transformation or effect within Far range.

equipment.name: Berserker’s Brew
equipment.rules: When you drink this dram of liquid, you gain a bonus to your Strength and a penalty to your Finesse and Knowledge equal to your Instinct (minimum 1). This effect lasts until you make a death move or until your next rest.

equipment.name: Emberite Shard
equipment.rules: Choose a point within Far range. All targets within Close range of that point must succeed on a Reaction Roll (16) or take 3d6 magic damage and become temporarily Ablaze. While Ablaze, a creature must roll a d4 whenever they make an action roll. On a result of 1, they mark a Hit Point. On a result of 4, they clear the Ablaze condition.

equipment.name: Arcticite Shard
equipment.rules: Choose a point within Far range. All targets within Close range of that point must succeed on a Reaction Roll (16) or take 3d6 magic damage and become temporarily Restrained by ice.

equipment.name: Fulgurite Shard
equipment.rules: Choose a point within Far range. All targets within Close range of that point must succeed on a Reaction Roll (16) or take 3d6 magic damage and mark 1d4 Stress as lightning crackles through the area.

equipment.name: Demiurge’s Draught
equipment.rules: You can drink this draught to gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency for your next successful attack roll.

equipment.name: Cockerel Claw Tea
equipment.rules: You can drink this tea to refresh your features as if you had taken a long rest.

equipment.name: Potion of Vigilance
equipment.rules: You can drink this potion to gain a +1 bonus to your Evasion until you mark a Hit Point.

equipment.name: Cacophonous Concoction
equipment.rules: When you drink this potion, anything you say or do in the next hour becomes impossible for a witness to recount. Any attempts they make to communicate what they saw, heard, or otherwise sensed comes out garbled or nonsensical.

equipment.name: Nightmare Mead
equipment.rules: You can drink this potion to discover the deepest fear of the next person you make eye contact with. When you do, the GM gains a Fear.

equipment.name: Stake of Abjuration
equipment.rules: You can hammer this stake into the ground and make a proclamation. Until your next rest, a creature within Far range of the stake who transgresses that proclamation must mark a Stress. The stake lasts until your next rest, then it shatters.

equipment.name: Psychopomp’s Shroud
equipment.rules: You can place this shroud over the corpse of a recently deceased creature. The creature’s spirit enters the shroud and becomes your spectral assistant until the next sunrise, when they pass through the veil of death and take the shroud with them.

equipment.name: Phial of Deep Ink
equipment.rules: You can drink this bottle of ink to transform into a cephalopod of roughly your size for the next hour. You gain rubbery skin, soft bones, the ability to breathe underwater, and new limbs until you have eight total.

equipment.name: Mesmer’s Tonic
equipment.rules: When you drink this tonic, the only thing you can hear until your next rest are the surface thoughts of creatures within Very Close range.

equipment.name: Invisibility Potion
equipment.rules: You are Hidden until you deal damage to another creature or until your next rest.

equipment.name: Formoid Serum
equipment.rules: You can drink this potion to become a swarm of 16 million ants until the end of the scene. You keep and have access to all equipment, loot, and features.

equipment.name: Steelskin Salve
equipment.rules: You can apply this salve to your skin to gain a bonus to your damage thresholds equal to your tier until the end of the scene.

equipment.name: Godling’s Pomelo
equipment.rules: You can eat this citrus fruit to clear all Hit Points and Stress.

equipment.name: Snakeskin Spirit
equipment.rules: You can drink this potion to slough off your outer layer of skin and heal a scar.

equipment.name: Magic-User’s Malison
equipment.rules: When you release this spellcaster’s trapped soul, you can cast one spell from a card in your vault as if it were in your loadout. This doesn’t work for permanently vaulted cards.

equipment.name: Quintessential Severant
equipment.rules: You can use this magic blade to cut one magical or metaphysical bond, such as an enchantment, contract, magical tether, or divine oath. When you do, the blade shatters.

equipment.name: Mask of the Echoed Self
equipment.rules: You can wear this mask during your next level up to swap the values of any of your traits. When you do, the mask becomes your permanent face.

equipment.name: Necroprancer’s Bell
equipment.rules: You can break this rusted, clapperless bell against the ground to summon a skeletal steed that climbs out of the earth and serves you until the next sunrise.

equipment.name: Drakemantle
equipment.rules: You can use this enchanted ancient dragon hide to gain draconic characteristics until the end of the scene, when the hide falls aways in tatters. Until then, you can fly and gain a +5 bonus to your damage thresholds and a +1 bonus to your Proficiency.

equipment.name: Gambler’s Fallacy
equipment.rules: You can spend any number of handfuls of gold by placing them into this slotted ceramic jar shaped like a pig. When you throw the jar at a point within Far range, it explodes and deals 1d20 magic damage for each handful of gold spent to all creatures within Close range of that point. All gold within the jar is destroyed.

equipment.name: Lionheart Tonic
equipment.rules: You can drink this tonic to gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency until you roll with Fear.

equipment.name: Tears of the Undying Hero
equipment.rules: When you drink this potion, death can’t touch you until your next long rest. When you would mark your last Hit Point, instead of making a death move, you make one final action roll before falling into a dreamless slumber until an ally chooses the Tend to Wounds downtime move to clear your Hit Points.

equipment.name: Featherstep Potion
equipment.rules: You can drink this potion to sprout small wings from your ankles that give you a bonus to your Evasion equal to your tier until your next rest.

equipment.name: Premium Bedroll
equipment.rules: During downtime, you automatically clear a Stress.

equipment.name: Piper Whistle
equipment.rules: This handcrafted whistle has a distinctive sound. When you blow this whistle, its piercing tone can be heard within a 1-mile radius.

equipment.name: Charging Quiver
equipment.rules: When you succeed on an attack with an arrow stored in this quiver, gain a bonus to the damage roll equal to your current tier.

equipment.name: Alistair’s Torch
equipment.rules: You can light this magic torch at will. The flame’s light fills a much larger space than it should, enough to illuminate a cave bright as day.

equipment.name: Speaking Orbs
equipment.rules: This pair of orbs allows any creatures holding them to communicate with each other across any distance.

equipment.name: Manacles
equipment.rules: This pair of locking cuffs comes with a key.

equipment.name: Arcane Cloak
equipment.rules: A creature with a Spellcast trait wearing this cloak can adjust its color, texture, and size at will.

equipment.name: Woven Net
equipment.rules: You can make a Finesse Roll using this net to trap a small creature. A trapped target can break free with a successful Attack Roll (16).

equipment.name: Fire Jar
equipment.rules: You can pour out the strange liquid contents of this jar to instantly produce fire. The contents regenerate when you take a long rest.

equipment.name: Suspended Rod
equipment.rules: This flat rod is inscribed with runes. When you activate the rod, it is immediately suspended in place. Until the rod is deactivated, it can’t move, doesn’t abide by the rules of gravity, and remains in place.

equipment.name: Glamour Stone
equipment.rules: Activate this pebble-sized stone to memorize the appearance of someone you can see. Spend a Hope to magically recreate this guise on yourself as an illusion.

equipment.name: Empty Chest
equipment.rules: This magical chest appears empty. When you speak a specific trigger word or action and open the chest, you can see the items stored within it.

equipment.name: Companion Case
equipment.rules: This case can fit a small animal companion. While the companion is inside, the animal and case are immune to all damage and harmful effects.

equipment.name: Piercing Arrows
equipment.rules: Three times per rest when you succeed on an attack with one of these arrows, you can add your Proficiency to the damage roll.

equipment.name: Valorstone
equipment.rules: You can attach this stone to armor that doesn’t already have a feature. The armor gains the following feature. Resilient: Before you mark your last Armor Slot, roll a d6. On a result of 6, reduce the severity by one threshold without marking an Armor Slot.

equipment.name: Skeleton Key
equipment.rules: When you use this key to open a locked door, you gain advantage on the Finesse Roll.

equipment.name: Arcane Prism
equipment.rules: Position this prism in a location of your choosing and activate it. All allies within Close range of it gain a +1 bonus to their Spellcast Rolls. While activated, the prism can’t be moved. Once the prism is deactivated, it can’t be activated again until your next long rest.

equipment.name: Minor Stamina Potion Recipe
equipment.rules: As a downtime move, you can use the bone of a creature to craft a Minor Stamina Potion.

equipment.name: Minor Health Potion Recipe
equipment.rules: As a downtime move, you can use a vial of blood to craft a Minor Health Potion.

equipment.name: Homing Compasses
equipment.rules: These two compasses point toward each other no matter how far apart they are.

equipment.name: Corrector Sprite
equipment.rules: This tiny sprite sits in the curve of your ear canal and whispers helpful advice during combat. Once per short rest, you can gain advantage on an attack roll.

equipment.name: Gecko Gloves
equipment.rules: You can climb up vertical surfaces and across ceilings.

equipment.name: Lorekeeper
equipment.rules: You can store the name and details of up to three hostile creatures inside this book. You gain a +1 bonus to action rolls against those creatures.

equipment.name: Vial of Darksmoke Recipe
equipment.rules: As a downtime move, you can mark a Stress to craft a Vial of Darksmoke.

equipment.name: Bloodstone
equipment.rules: You can attach this stone to a weapon that doesn’t already have a feature. The weapon gains the following feature. Brutal: When you roll the maximum value on a damage die, roll an additional damage die.

equipment.name: Greatstone
equipment.rules: You can attach this stone to a weapon that doesn’t already have a feature. The weapon gains the following feature. Powerful: On a successful attack, roll an additional damage die and discard the lowest result.

equipment.name: Glider
equipment.rules: While falling, you can mark a Stress to deploy this small parachute and glide safely to the ground.

equipment.name: Ring of Silence
equipment.rules: Spend a Hope to activate this ring. Your footsteps are silent until your next rest.

equipment.name: Calming Pendant
equipment.rules: When you would mark your last Stress, roll a d6. On a result of 5 or higher, don’t mark it.

equipment.name: Dual Flask
equipment.rules: This flask can hold two different liquids. You can swap between them by flipping a small switch on the flask’s side.

equipment.name: Bag of Ficklesand
equipment.rules: You can convince this small bag of sand to be much heavier or lighter with a successful Presence Roll (10). Additionally, on a successful Finesse Roll (10), you can blow a bit of sand into a target’s face to make them temporarily Vulnerable.

equipment.name: Ring of Resistance
equipment.rules: Once per long rest, you can activate this ring after a successful attack against you to halve the damage.

equipment.name: Phoenix Feather
equipment.rules: If you have at least one Phoenix Feather on you when you fall unconscious, you gain a +1 bonus to the roll you make to determine whether you gain a scar.

equipment.name: Box of Many Goods
equipment.rules: Once per long rest, you can open this small box and roll a d12. On a result of 1–6, it’s empty. On a result of 7–10, it contains one random common consumable. On a result of 11–12, it contains two random common consumables.

equipment.name: Airblade Charm
equipment.rules: You can attach this charm to a weapon with a Melee range. Three times per rest, you can activate the charm and attack a target within Close range.

equipment.name: Portal Seed
equipment.rules: You can plant this seed in the ground to grow a portal in that spot. The portal is ready to use in 24 hours. You can use this portal to travel to any other location where you planted a portal seed. A portal can be destroyed by dealing any amount of magic damage to it.

equipment.name: Paragon’s Chain
equipment.rules: As a downtime move, you can meditate on an ideal or principle you hold dear and focus your will into this chain. Once per long rest, you can spend a Hope to roll a d20 as your Hope Die for rolls that directly align with that principle.

equipment.name: Elusive Amulet
equipment.rules: Once per long rest, you can activate this amulet to become Hidden until you move. While Hidden in this way, you remain unseen even if an adversary moves to where they would normally see you.

equipment.name: Hopekeeper Locket
equipment.rules: During a long rest, if you have 6 Hope, you can spend a Hope to imbue this locket with your bountiful resolve. When you have 0 Hope, you can use the locket to immediately gain a Hope. The locket must be re-imbued before it can be used this way again.

equipment.name: Infinite Bag
equipment.rules: When you store items in this bag, they are kept in a pocket dimension that never runs out of space. You can retrieve an item at any time.

equipment.name: Stride Relic
equipment.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to your Agility. You can only carry one relic.

equipment.name: Bolster Relic
equipment.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to your Strength. You can only carry one relic.

equipment.name: Control Relic
equipment.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to your Finesse. You can only carry one relic.

equipment.name: Attune Relic
equipment.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to your Instinct. You can only carry one relic.

equipment.name: Charm Relic
equipment.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to your Presence. You can only carry one relic.

equipment.name: Enlighten Relic
equipment.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to your Knowledge. You can only carry one relic.

equipment.name: Honing Relic
equipment.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to an Experience of your choice. You can only carry one relic.

equipment.name: Flickerfly Pendant
equipment.rules: While you carry this pendant, your weapons with a Melee range that deal physical damage have a gossamer sheen and can attack targets within Very Close range.

equipment.name: Lakestrider Boots
equipment.rules: You can walk on the surface of water as if it were soft ground.

equipment.name: Clay Companion
equipment.rules: When you sculpt this ball of clay into a clay animal companion, it behaves as that animal. For example, a clay spider can spin clay webs, while a clay bird can fly. The clay companion retains memory and identity across different shapes, but they can adopt new mannerisms with each form.

equipment.name: Mythic Dust Recipe
equipment.rules: As a downtime move, you can use a handful of fine gold dust to craft Mythic Dust.

equipment.name: Shard of Memory
equipment.rules: Once per long rest, you can spend 2 Hope to recall a domain card from your vault instead of paying its Recall Cost.

equipment.name: Gem of Alacrity
equipment.rules: You can attach this gem to a weapon, allowing you to use your Agility when making an attack with that weapon.

equipment.name: Gem of Might
equipment.rules: You can attach this gem to a weapon, allowing you to use your Strength when making an attack with that weapon.

equipment.name: Gem of Precision
equipment.rules: You can attach this gem to a weapon, allowing you to use your Finesse when making an attack with that weapon.

equipment.name: Gem of Insight
equipment.rules: You can attach this gem to a weapon, allowing you to use your Instinct when making an attack with that weapon.

equipment.name: Gem of Audacity
equipment.rules: You can attach this gem to a weapon, allowing you to use your Presence when making an attack with that weapon.

equipment.name: Gem of Sagacity
equipment.rules: You can attach this gem to a weapon, allowing you to use your Knowledge when making an attack with that weapon.

equipment.name: Ring of Unbreakable Resolve
equipment.rules: Once per session, when the GM spends a Fear, you can spend 4 Hope to cancel the effects of that spent Fear.

equipment.name: Belt of Unity
equipment.rules: Once per session, you can spend 5 Hope to lead a Tag Team Roll with three PCs instead of two.

equipment.name: Caltrops
equipment.rules: You can spread these caltrops in a Very Close area around you. A creature hastening through that area must mark a Stress.

equipment.name: Grapnel
equipment.rules: You gain advantage on action rolls to climb sheer surfaces.

equipment.name: Ball Bearings
equipment.rules: This pouch contains perfectly smooth metal spheres.

equipment.name: Box of Dragon Dust
equipment.rules: This snuffbox is filled with combustible powder.

equipment.name: Nighthawker’s Ring
equipment.rules: Spend a Hope to activate the gemstone in this ring until the end of the scene. While active, the gemstone changes color to indicate the wearer’s proximity to hidden treasure: warm colors for near, cool colors for far.

equipment.name: Elven Spyglass
equipment.rules: You can use this spyglass to magnify your vision a hundredfold.

equipment.name: Gourmet Granules
equipment.rules: This savory powder makes any food it’s sprinkled on delicious and healthy, no matter how bland or rotten it is.

equipment.name: Collapsible Pole
equipment.rules: You can break down this 18-foot pole into six interlinked 3-foot segments.

equipment.name: Blackwing Quill
equipment.rules: This writing quill never runs out of ink or needs to be sharpened.

equipment.name: Silee’s Folding Knife
equipment.rules: This 3-inch blade has an edge that easily cuts through anything except the handle it’s stored in.

equipment.name: Windup Toy
equipment.rules: This small mechanical device is shaped like a strixwolf pup and can be programmed to perform simple tricks.

equipment.name: Loaded Dice
equipment.rules: You can choose what result this set of weighted dice rolls with a successful Finesse Roll (14). If you roll with Fear, anyone watching knows the dice are loaded.

equipment.name: Hollowbark Horn
equipment.rules: You can blow this horn to summon a small woodland creature to perform a simple task.

equipment.name: Self-Tying Rope
equipment.rules: You can command this rope to tie or untie itself.

equipment.name: Thief’s Compass
equipment.rules: This compass points the way toward the nearest exit while indoors and the closest entrance while outdoors.

equipment.name: Traveler’s Bell
equipment.rules: Once per long rest, you can ring this bell to magically open the shortest safe path through rough terrain for 1 hour.

equipment.name: Mandragorian Torch
equipment.rules: This torch gives off light only the bearer can see.

equipment.name: Boots of Supple Mystique
equipment.rules: While wearing these boots, you don’t leave tracks or footprints.

equipment.name: Zephyr’s Jar
equipment.rules: You can open this empty jar during inclement weather to capture the storm and leave behind clear skies. The storm remains inside until unleashed by reopening the jar.

equipment.name: Returning Ring
equipment.rules: When you throw your primary weapon while wearing this ring, the weapon appears in your hand immediately after the attack.

equipment.name: Kingfisher’s Net
equipment.rules: Once per long rest, you can use this net to scoop one live fish out of any amount of water, no matter how unlikely it is for that water to have fish in it.

equipment.name: Titan’s Girdle
equipment.rules: Once per scene, you can activate this girdle to gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency for your next attack.

equipment.name: Iron Veil
equipment.rules: This chain-link head covering renders the wearer invisible to fey creatures.

equipment.name: Furball Bag
equipment.rules: Once per rest, you can produce 2d20 harmless, cat-sized fur creatures of indeterminate origin and species from this bag.

equipment.name: Whisperstep Anklet
equipment.rules: This anklet makes your steps silent as long as you don’t move faster than walking speed.

equipment.name: Enchanter’s Loupe
equipment.rules: You can use this loupe to see through illusions and enchantments.

equipment.name: Escher’s Mirrorball
equipment.rules: Once per long rest, you can command this fist-sized silver orb to capture an omnidirectional image of its surroundings on its surface. This image lasts until your next long rest.

equipment.name: Cheater’s Coin
equipment.rules: When you flip this coin, you can spend a Hope to determine which side it lands on.

equipment.name: Gravewarden’s Bell
equipment.rules: This bell rings when a ghost or undead creature moves within Far range of it.

equipment.name: Reliquary of the Sightless Saint
equipment.rules: You gain a +1 bonus to your Hope Die when you make the Risk It All death move.

equipment.name: Map of Revelation
equipment.rules: You can attune this map to one creature at a time. The map always shows the attuned creature’s location.

equipment.name: Dagginae’s Obsidian Slate
equipment.rules: This wafer-thin sheet of volcanic glass is used by archivists to keep notes. Any information etched onto its surface disappears but can be recalled via a command you set.

equipment.name: Gadiman’s Backpack
equipment.rules: Once per rest, you can spend a Hope to conjure a mundane item up to a cubic foot in size inside this satchel.

equipment.name: Eclipse Coin
equipment.rules: Once per rest, flip a coin. On heads, you gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls until your next successful attack. On tails, you gain +1 to your Evasion until an attack fails against you.

equipment.name: Sorcerer’s Hat
equipment.rules: This conical blue hat is covered in silver stars. Once per rest, you can cast a spell from your vault with a Recall Cost equal to or less than your tier. This doesn’t work for permanently vaulted cards.

equipment.name: Ghoulskin Gloves
equipment.rules: When you attack with a physical weapon while wearing these gloves, the damage is considered both physical and magic.

equipment.name: Gloves of Alacrity
equipment.rules: When you would mark a Stress to reload a weapon, you don’t mark it.

equipment.name: Insomniac’s Periapt
equipment.rules: When you take a rest without clearing Hit Points or Stress, you gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls until your next rest.

equipment.name: Wildrider’s Saddle
equipment.rules: This saddle grants any animal it’s strapped onto the ability to understand their rider’s commands.

equipment.name: Soul-Twin Circlets
equipment.rules: Two creatures can wear this pair of circlets. You can spend a Hope to switch places with whoever is wearing the other circlet.

equipment.name: Namer’s Oracle
equipment.rules: Once per session, you can roll this set of runic dice to reveal the full name of the last person you touched.

equipment.name: Crucible Frames
equipment.rules: These eyeglasses reveal weak points in objects and creatures. Three times per rest, you can spend a Hope to gain advantage on an attack roll.

equipment.name: Two-Faced Aegis Brooch
equipment.rules: Once per rest, flip a coin. On heads, you become immune to the next physical damage you take. On tails, you become immune to the next magic damage you take.

equipment.name: Knockback Bracelets
equipment.rules: On a successful weapon attack, you can knock your target back up to Close range from their location.

equipment.name: Force Disc
equipment.rules: This shimmering two-dimensional disc of magical force has a 4-foot diameter and is magically tethered to a pebble. The disc always floats 3 feet north of, and at the same elevation as, the pebble. The pebble has a mass equal to one-hundredth of the total mass carried by the disc.

equipment.name: Molepaw Mittens
equipment.rules: Spend a Hope to swim through earth as if it were water for the next 10 minutes.

equipment.name: Timekeeper’s Pendant
equipment.rules: You can choose an additional downtime move each rest.

equipment.name: Iron Dagger Pendant
equipment.rules: Once per long rest, you can spend a Hope to tell the pendant a creature’s name. The pendant gently pulls you toward that creature’s current location until your next long rest.

equipment.name: Collar of Ascendancy
equipment.rules: An animal who wears this collar gains the ability to speak and understand common speech.

equipment.name: Temporal Sanctuary
equipment.rules: A PC who takes a rest in the temporal sanctuary can choose an additional downtime move.

equipment.name: Hero’s Helm
equipment.rules: When you critically succeed on an attack, all allies within Close range gain a Hope.

equipment.name: Rings of Friendship
equipment.rules: Two creatures can wear this pair of rings shaped like coiled snakes. You can spend the Hope of whoever is wearing the other ring (with their permission) as if it were your own.

equipment.name: Rings of Camaraderie
equipment.rules: Two creatures can wear this pair of wooden rings. You can mark the Stress of whoever is wearing the other ring (with their permission) as if it were your own.

equipment.name: Rings of Alliance
equipment.rules: Two creatures can wear this pair of rose gold rings. Once per session, you can initiate a Tag Team Roll with whoever is wearing the other ring without spending Hope or counting against your session limit for Tag Team Rolls.

equipment.name: Phobophage’s Circlet
equipment.rules: When the GM spends a Fear, roll a d4. Once per scene on a result of 4, you clear a Stress.

equipment.name: Quillshawl
equipment.rules: If an adversary attacks you within Melee range, they must succeed on a Reaction Roll (12) or mark a Hit Point.

equipment.name: Warp Pendant

equipment.name: Portal Frames

equipment.name: Communion Relic

levelUpOptions.name: Level 2 tier achievement
levelUpOptions.rules: At level 2, you gain a new Experience at +2 and permanently increase your Proficiency by 1.

levelUpOptions.name: Level 5 tier achievement
levelUpOptions.rules: At level 5, you gain a new Experience at +2, permanently increase your Proficiency by 1, and clear any marked traits.

levelUpOptions.name: Level 8 tier achievement
levelUpOptions.rules: At level 8, you gain a new Experience at +2, permanently increase your Proficiency by 1, and clear any marked traits.

levelUpOptions.name: Increase two traits
levelUpOptions.rules: Choose two unmarked character traits and gain a permanent +1 bonus to them. You can’t increase these stats again until the next tier (when your tier achievement allows you to clear those marks).

levelUpOptions.name: Add a Hit Point slot
levelUpOptions.rules: Darken the outline of the next rectangle in the Hit Point section of your character sheet in pen or permanent marker.

levelUpOptions.name: Add a Stress slot
levelUpOptions.rules: Darken the outline of the next rectangle in the Stress section of your character sheet in pen or permanent marker.

levelUpOptions.name: Increase two Experiences
levelUpOptions.rules: Choose two Experiences on your character sheet and gain a permanent +1 bonus to both.

levelUpOptions.name: Take an additional domain card
levelUpOptions.rules: You can choose an additional domain card at or below your level or from your class’s domains. If you’ve multiclassed, you can instead select a card at or below half your level from your chosen multiclass domain.

levelUpOptions.name: Increase Evasion
levelUpOptions.rules: Gain a permanent +1 bonus to your Evasion.

levelUpOptions.name: Take an upgraded subclass card
levelUpOptions.rules: Take the next card for your subclass. If you have only the foundation card, take a specialization; if you have a specialization already, take a mastery. Then cross out this tier’s multiclass option.

levelUpOptions.name: Increase Proficiency
levelUpOptions.rules: Fill in one of the open circles in the “Proficiency” section of your character sheet, then increase your weapon’s number of damage dice by 1. The black box around this advancement’s slots indicates you must spend two advancements and mark both level-up slots in order to take it as an option.

levelUpOptions.name: Multiclass
levelUpOptions.rules:
Choose an additional class, select one of its domains, and gain its class feature. Add the appropriate multiclass module to your character sheet and take the foundation card from one of its subclasses. Then cross out the “upgraded subclass” advancement option in this tier and all other “multiclass” advancement options on your character sheet. The black box around this advancement’s slots indicates you must spend two advancements and mark both level-up slots in order to take it as an option.
Starting at level 5, you can choose multiclassing as an option when leveling up. When you multiclass, you choose an additional class, gain access to one of its domains, and acquire its class feature. Take the appropriate multiclass module and add it to the right side of your character sheet, then choose a foundation card from one of its subclasses. If your foundation cards specify different Spellcast traits, you can choose which one to apply when making a Spellcast roll.
Whenever you have the option to acquire a new domain card, you can choose from cards at or below half your current level (rounded up) from the domain you chose when you selected the multiclass advancement.

levelUpOptions.name: Damage thresholds
levelUpOptions.rules: Step Three: Damage Thresholds Increase all damage thresholds by 1.

levelUpOptions.name: New domain card
levelUpOptions.rules: Step Four: Domain Cards Acquire a new domain card at your level or lower from one of your class’s domains and add it to your loadout or vault. If your loadout is already full, you can’t add the new card to it until you move another into your vault. You can also exchange one domain card you’ve previously acquired for a different domain card of the same level or lower.

levelUpOptions.name: Increase Combo Die
levelUpOptions.rules: Your Combo Die starts as a d4. Once per tier, you can increase your Combo Die by one step as a level advancement option.

levelUpOptions.name: Choose an additional stance
levelUpOptions.rules: Take the Martial Stances sheet and choose two martial stances from Tier 1. Each time you level up your character, choose an additional stance from your tier or lower.

levelUpOptions.name: Choose a companion level-up option
levelUpOptions.rules: Take the Ranger Companion sheet. When you level up your character, choose a level-up option for your companion from this sheet as well.
